No. Name. Address. Business hours.

1 Union of Russian Association and Committee for the Defence of Russian Rights and Interests in Shanghai (includes 7 organizations. President N.A.Ivanoff 876 Avenue Joffre 112 Szechuen Rd. 9 a.m. to noon 2 p.m. to 5 p.m.

2 Mr. V.F.Grosse, Ex-Imperial Russian Consul General in Shanghai, Chairman of the Russian Relief Association "Help." 6A. Hongkong Rd. 10 a.m. to noon 2 p.m. to 4 p.m. (interviews) 9 a.m. to noon 5 p.m. to 7-p.m. (office).

9 Russian Youth's Circle. Rue Rataid.

11 Society of Russian Intellectuals. No.office.

14 Madame Disterichs Home. 604 Rue Conty.

letter No. 128 dated June 17, on the subject of

that failure on your part to comply with this warning

June 20, 19 29）

Subject (in full) The Society of New Born Russia.

Made by D. S. Ovsianikoff. Forwarded by J W Robertson C. D. I.

With reference to the attached letter No. 128, dated May
17, 1929 from the Society of New Born Russia, inquiries go to show
that the said Society was first organised in Russia in 1920 by the
Prince of Oldenburg but owing to the general retreat of the White
Russian troops from Russia the Society automatically ceased to
exist. In the end of April 1929 Mr. V. Lomakin, Russian Monarchist
leader arrived in Shanghai from Mukden and with the assistance of
Mr. N. Koulchitsky, also a member of the Russian Monarchist group
re-established the Society in Shanghai. In May 1929 the Society
opened an office at 113 Avenue Edward VII where new members are
recruited and all business pertaining to the association transacted.
The aim of the Society is to endeavour to bring about the unifica-
tion of all White Russian abroad and in Russia into one group for
the downfall of the Communist regime in Russia. The Society has
agents in USSR, who are engaged in the distribution of various
pamphlets among the population of USSR. The Society has no funds
at present to further their activities but negotiation are being
conducted between Mr. V. Lomakin, President of the Society and the
Nationalist Government in Nanking to obtain funds on certain condi-
tion. It is reported that the Society consists at present of 220
members only and the following persons constitute the committee.

Mr. V. M. Lomakin President
Mr. N. Koulchitsky Vice President
Mrs. L. I. Wittin-Wilson Member
Mrs. E. E. Kandiba "
Mr. A. V. Kataneff "
Mr. N. Lomakin Secretary

The attached is the statute and programe of the Society which was
received from Mr. Lomakin President of the association.

（批：W.R. 2059. A/ D. C. I. MJS 21/6/29）
V. Ovsiannikoff
D. S.

事由（全称）：新生俄罗斯协会。

由 D. S. Ovsianikoff 撰写。由 J W Robertson 刑事调查处转呈。

关于随附的1929年5月17日来自新生俄罗斯协会的第128号信函，经查询显示，该协会最初由奥尔登堡亲王（Prince of Oldenburg）于1920年在俄罗斯组织成立，但由于白俄军队从俄罗斯全面撤退，该协会自动停止存在。1929年4月底，俄国君主派领导人 V. Lomakin 先生从沈阳抵达上海，并在同为俄国君主派团体成员的 N. Koulchitsky 先生的协助下，在上海重建了该协会。1929年5月，该协会在爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）113号开设办事处，在此招募新会员并处理与该协会有关的所有事务。该协会的宗旨是致力于将海外及俄罗斯境内的所有白俄统一为一个团体，以推翻俄罗斯的共产主义政权。该协会在苏联境内设有代理人，负责在苏联民众中分发各种小册子。该协会目前缺乏进一步开展活动的资金，但协会主席 V. Lomakin 先生正与南京国民政府进行谈判，以期在特定条件下获得资金。据报，该协会目前仅有220名成员，委员会由以下人员组成：

V. M. Lomakin 先生 主席
N. Koulchitsky 先生 副主席
L. I. Wittin-Wilson 夫人 委员
E. E. Kandiba 夫人 "
A. V. Kataneff 先生 "
N. Lomakin 先生 秘书

随附的是从该协会主席 Lomakin 先生处收到的协会章程和纲领。

STATUTE and PROGRAMME
of
The New Born Russia Association
established in the year 1918.
Regulations Governing the Mutual
Aid Savings Bank.

THE STATUTE

Purpose of the Association. 1. The purpose of the Association
known as the New Born Russia Association is the unification
of all Russian people in whose interests it is to see the
re-establishment of One whole Russia by means of promoting
in the public mind of national and traditional customs peculiar
to the Great Imperial Russia.

2. The tasks of the Association will include the organizations
of fraternities, the opening and maintaining of schools, libraries,
old people's homes, orphanages, hospitals, mutual aid savings
banks, food co-operatives, assistance to members of the
Association, the holding of classes, lectures, excursions,
soirees and theatrical plays, publication of newspapers, pamphlets,
hand-bills and other various activity of educational and patriotic
nature.

Funds of the Association. 3. Funds of the Association are
formed with members' fees, donations, profits from property
and other receipts.

Composition and Arrangement of the Association. 4. The New Born
Russia Association is to be composed of Members Promoters, who
sign a Promoters' Act and who are made life members of the
Association, honourary members and regular members. Persons
of Christian Faith irrespective of Sex are eligible for membership
"pon the attainment of age and having had no Court convictions.

5. Persons wishing to become Members of the Association
make an application to the Board of the Association. Persons
made members of the Association pay the established fee.

6. The Association has its Board of Administration in Shanghai
and its Seal.

7. The Association protects Members of the Association.

8. The Board of Administration of the Association is composed
of five members elected for three years by the General Assembly
of the Members Promoters of the Association, two Candidates
and three members of the Revision Commission.
page_data.zh:
新生俄罗斯协会
章程与纲领
成立于1918年。
互助储蓄银行管理条例。

章程

协会宗旨。1. 名为“新生俄罗斯协会”的协会，其宗旨是团结所有俄罗斯人，他们的利益在于通过促进公众心目中特有的大俄罗斯帝国的民族和传统习俗，来实现一个完整统一的俄罗斯的重建。

2. 协会的任务包括组织兄弟会，开办和维持学校、图书馆、养老院、孤儿院、医院、互助储蓄银行、食品合作社，援助协会会员，举办课程、讲座、远足、晚会和戏剧演出，出版报纸、小册子、传单以及其他各种具有教育和爱国性质的活动。

协会资金。3. 协会资金由会员费、捐款、财产收益和其他收入构成。

协会的组成与架构。4. 新生俄罗斯协会由发起会员、荣誉会员和普通会员组成。发起会员签署发起书，并成为协会的终身会员。凡基督教信仰者，不分性别，达到法定年龄且无法院定罪记录者，均有资格成为会员。

5. 希望成为协会会员的人应向协会理事会提出申请。被接纳为会员的人需缴纳规定的会费。

6. 协会在上海设有行政理事会及其印章。

7. 协会保护其会员。

8. 协会行政理事会由五名成员组成，由协会发起会员大会选举产生，任期三年；另设两名候补成员和三名审计委员会成员。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

9. Members elected for the Board elect from amongst themselves
President, Treasurer and Secretary, but these may be elected
by the General Assembly of the Promoters as well.

10. Members of the Board must meet at least once a week.

11. The Board are empowered to act on behalf of the Association
as follows:- enter into any agreement, issue documents and
powers of attorney, receive money due to the Association,
and represent the Association before officials, administration
and Court as well as run all the affairs and handle the property
of the Association. The Board of the Association is entitled
to approach Government institutions and private people with
petitions and receive documents of every description. All out-
going documents must bear the signature of President or Acting
President, Secretary and a Member of the Board.

12. A General Meeting of the Members Promoters of the Association
is convened by the Board half yearly. At these General Meetings
one of the Members Promoters presides over the meeting, being
elected at every meeting held.

13. The General meeting of the Members Promoters examines and
approves of accounts and budgets as presented by the Board.
It issues instructions to the Board and sanctions Members of
the Association for their respective posts upon the representation
of the Board.

14. Decisions made at the General Meetings of the Members Promoters
of the Association are binding for all members of the
Association and cannot be appealed.

15. A General Meeting of the Members Promoters and Regular
Members of the Association is recognized as being held in
the presence of one third of the total membership of the
Association. In the absence of such number, a second meeting
is convened on the same day three hours later when a meeting
is considered held irrespective of the number of Members of
the Association present.

16. All matters at a meeting are decided by the majority of
votes and in the event of equal number the vote of the President
decides.

17. Revision of the funds and accounts is made by the
Revision Commission every month.

----------

Closing of the Association. 18. The closing of the Association,
the disposal of its property and capital is decided upon by
the General Meeting of the Members Promoters and the Regular
Members of the Association.

----------

PROGRAMME

1. The New Born Russia Association has set upon a task of
freeing Russia and the Russian People from Bolshevist power
and after uniting Russia to include her in the family of Great
Powers of the world once again.

2. In order to attain the above end lawfulness and good order
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

9. 当选为理事会的成员从中选举主席、司库和秘书，但这些职位也可由发起会员大会选举产生。

10. 理事会成员必须至少每周开会一次。

11. 理事会有权代表协会采取以下行动：签订任何协议，签发文件和授权委托书，收取属于协会的款项，并在官员、行政机构和法庭面前代表协会，以及处理协会的所有事务和管理协会财产。协会有权向政府机构和私人提出请愿并接收各类文件。所有发出的文件必须带有主席或代理主席、秘书以及一名理事会成员的签名。

12. 协会发起会员大会由理事会每半年召开一次。在这些大会上，由每次会议选举产生的一名发起会员主持会议。

13. 发起会员大会审查并批准理事会提交的账目和预算。它向理事会发出指示，并根据理事会的提名批准协会会员担任各自职务。

14. 协会发起会员大会作出的决定对所有协会会员具有约束力，不得上诉。

15. 协会发起会员和普通会员的大会，在有协会总会员数三分之一出席的情况下，方视为有效召开。如果未达到此人数，则于同日三小时后召开第二次会议，届时无论出席的协会会员人数多少，均视为会议有效召开。

16. 会议上所有事项均由多数票决定，如遇票数相等，则由主席投票决定。

17. 审计委员会每月对资金和账目进行审计。

----------

协会的关闭。18. 协会的关闭、其财产和资本的处理，由协会发起会员和普通会员大会决定。

----------

纲领

1. 新生俄罗斯协会确立了一项任务，即把俄罗斯和俄罗斯人民从布尔什维克权力下解放出来，并在统一俄罗斯后，使其再次跻身于世界列强之林。

2. 为了达到上述目的，法治和良好的秩序

page_data.en:
- 3 -

are necessary above everything else. A governing power should
not only govern, but also serve the people, teaching everywhere
respect for humanity and family as the foundation of a State.

3. The State and the society must take special care of the Holy
Orthodox Faith, allowing at the same time freedom to all
other professions of Faith to build their churches, houses of
prayer and have their Services. Without religion a human being
is likened to a beast.

4. Fathers and Mothers as heads of the family and being
responsible for their children before God and the People must
enjoy the special protection of the State. They are the
connecting link between the past and the present lives of the
people. A head of the family must be full master of his
property and nobody should interfere by right in his instructions.

5. The right of ownership must be sacred.

6. Land must become the property of the head of a family and
the owner of such must be given every co-operation in collecting
various lots and for this, purpose exchange, purchase and sale
of various lots should be authorized as well as the purchasing
of land from private individuals and the peasants' bank. Land
confiscated during the revolution will not be subject to return
except in the case of Church owned land lots. Extras of
land ownership should be bought over by the Government for
the sale to the population.

7. Trade and Industry must be guaranteed from outside
interference with the property owned and business freedom
allowed subject to observation of law and good order.

8. All labourers and workers should have improved conditions
of labour with a view to getting better pay and should have
a right to form unions, establish mutual aid savings banks
and obtain privileges improving conditions of life for the
labouring class.

9. In order to re-establish Russia it is necessary to
institute compulsory education for all citizens in low schools
and to promote practical lessons in agriculture and industry
for the popular masses.

10. Freedom of speech and freedom of the Press should be
granted subject, however, to punishment for false information.

11. The Russian people started the state of disturbance and it
is up to them to put a stop to it by means of establishing
in Russia a form of government to suit them. In the face of
the present state of destruction in the Country, the Association
is of opinion that the institution of a firm Monarchistic
and National Authority is necessary.

12. In order to attain their plans the people must seek support
in the army, as a force which submits to itself all outer
and inner enemies of the people. The Army is our hope and
our support.
----------
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

高于一切。统治权力不仅应当治理国家，还应当服务于人民，在任何地方教导人们尊重人性与家庭，将其作为国家的基础。

3. 国家和社会必须特别照顾东正教圣信，同时允许所有其他宗教信仰自由建造教堂、祈祷所并进行宗教仪式。没有宗教，人就如同野兽。

4. 父母作为家庭的主人，并在上帝和人民面前对子女负责，必须享受国家的特别保护。他们是连接人民过去与现在生活的纽带。一家之主必须是其财产的完全主人，任何人无权干涉其指令。

5. 所有权必须神圣不可侵犯。

6. 土地必须成为一家之主的财产，并且必须给予此类所有者各种便利以收集分散的地块；为此，应授权进行各地块的交换、买卖，以及从个人和农民银行购买土地。革命期间没收的土地不予归还，教会拥有的地块除外。超额的土地所有权应由政府收购，以便出售给民众。

7. 贸易和工业必须保证免受外部对其自有财产的干涉，并在遵守法律和良好秩序的前提下允许商业自由。

8. 所有劳工和工人应改善劳动条件，以获得更好的报酬，并应有权组建工会，建立互助储蓄银行，并获得改善劳工阶级生活条件的特权。

9. 为了重建俄罗斯，有必要对所有公民实行初等义务教育，并向广大民众推广农业和工业的实践课程。

10. 应给予言论自由和新闻自由，但须对虚假信息予以惩罚。

11. 俄罗斯人民开启了动荡的局面，他们有责任通过在俄罗斯建立适合他们的政府形式来终止这种局面。面对国家目前的破坏状态，本会认为有必要建立坚定的君主制和民族权威。

12. 为了实现他们的计划，人民必须在军队中寻求支持，因为军队是一支能使人民的所有内外敌人屈服的武力。军队是我们的希望和支持。
----------

page_data.en:
- 4 -
REGULATIONS GOVERNING
MUTUAL AID SAVINGS BANK.

24 paragraphs govern the Mutual Aid Savings Bank
functioning under the auspices of the New Born Russia
Association. The substance of these amounts to the
following:-
Mutual financial help by means of loans, etc. on
easy terms and 7%.
$ 2.00 entrance fee and $ 10.00 shares paid into the Bank
at 6% per annum for the shareholders. $2 is used for the
organizational purposes and is not subject to return. Loans
are granted for three months only and are limited to the
amount of shares held by the shareholder. Only members of
the New Born Russia Association are entitled to take part
in the Savings Banks transactions, etc.. Funds of the
Savings Bank are kept in some large Bank and amounts payable
are issued in cheques. The application for loans must be
made to the Board of the Bank, functioning in the New Born
Russia Association in accordance with established regulations.
Loans are limited to 50 dollars.
page_data.zh:
- 4 -
互助储蓄银行
管理条例。

共有24条条款管理在新生俄罗斯协会主持下运作的互助储蓄银行。这些条款的实质内容如下：
通过贷款等方式提供相互财政帮助，条件优惠，利率为7%。
入场费2.00美元，股东向银行缴纳的股金为10.00美元，年利率为6%。2美元用于组织目的，不予退还。贷款期限仅为三个月，且限于股东所持股金的金额。只有新生俄罗斯协会的会员才有资格参与储蓄银行的交易等。储蓄银行的资金存放在某家大型银行，应付款项以支票形式支付。贷款申请必须向银行理事会提出，该理事会在新生俄罗斯协会内按照既定条例运作。贷款限额为50美元。

（印：9259 15.8.28）

Extract from Intelligence Report dated
August 14, 1928.

Between 6 and 8.30 p.m. August 13 a private
meeting of the "Special Committee of the Unification of
Russian Emigrants" was held in the premises of the Union
of Russian Ex-Army and Navy Men, 876 Avenue Joffre.
Fifteen representatives of various Russian organizations
in Shanghai were present and the proceedings were under
the chairmanship of Captain Fonsin, Captain Belukovich
acting as Secretary. A letter from General Horvath to
the Committee of Defence of Russian Rights and Interests
was read. Therein the General stated that although he
had sent his representatives to interview the Mukden and
Nanking Governments in connection with Russian unification
work he did not think that an agreement would be reached
and concluded by urging the collecting of funds for
the organization of emigrants and for charitable purposes.
It was also proposed at the meeting that the Committee of
the Unification of Russian Emigrants be reorganized and
that the Committee for the Defence of Russian Rights and
Interests be re-elected. Mr. Ivanoff, Chairman of the
latter Committee, who was present, was called upon to
resign owing to his having given certificates in the name
of the Committee to certain well known Bolsheviks whose
names were not mentioned and to the fact that he is legal
adviser to Mr. Ulanoff, a Soviet citizen residing in
Shanghai. After much discussion it was decided to postpone
the meeting until instructions had been received from
General Horvath.
page_data.zh:
（印：9259 1928年8月15日）

摘自1928年8月14日的情报报告。

8月13日晚6时至8时30分，“俄国侨民统一特别委员会”在霞飞路876号前陆海军军人联合会的办公地点举行了一次非公开会议。上海各俄国团体的十五名代表出席，会议由丰辛（Fonsin）上尉主持，贝卢科维奇（Belukovich）上尉担任秘书。会上宣读了霍尔瓦特将军（General Horvath）致俄国权益维护委员会的一封信。信中，将军表示，尽管他已派遣代表就俄国统一工作与沈阳和南京政府进行接洽，但他认为不会达成协议，并敦促筹集资金，用于侨民组织和慈善目的。会议还提议改组俄国侨民统一委员会，并重新选举俄国权益维护委员会。后者主席伊万诺夫（Ivanoff）先生出席了会议，但因他以委员会名义向某些未具名的著名布尔什维克分子签发证书，且他是居住在上海的苏联公民乌拉诺夫（Ulanoff）先生的法律顾问，故被要求辞职。经过长时间讨论，决定推迟会议，直至收到霍尔瓦特将军的指示。

S.O. 古皮克（Gupik）。

原定于8月12日下午3时在霞飞路前陆海军军人联合会办公地点举行的上海哥萨克联合会会议，因某种未知原因未能召开。据报，俄国统一委员会将于8月13日下午6时在上述地点举行会议。

Translation of a letter addressed by the Chairman of the
meeting of the social organisations to Mr.Grosse, president of
the Emigrants' committee.

Shanghai, June 18, 1928.

Dear Sir,

The meeting of representatives of Shanghai social organisations
convoked on June 17 by the promoters of the organisation of a General
Meeting of the Russian Colony in Shanghai, has ██████ instructed
the Praesidium of the meeting, jointly with the promoters, to
inform you of the following:

The meeting has, in principle, acknowledged that the question
of the unification of the Russian Colony is a very important matter
and is to be solved without any delay. In view of the meeting not
having been attended by representatives of the Emigrants' Committee
and the organisations incorporated to it, the meeting has decided
to postpone the discussion of the question of ways and means of
unification and to postpone the sitting till June 24, at 4 p.m.,
and to request the Emigrants' Committee and organisations incorpo-
rated to it to send two ██████ representatives each with full
powers in writing.

The meeting has decided to request you to give a reply to the
Chairman of this meeting, or to the promoters, not later than on
June 22, of the decision of the Emigrants' Committee on this matter.

Informing you of the above I am etc.

(signatures)

Translation of excerpts from the minutes of the Russian Emigrants' Committee in Shanghai held on June 21, 1925

The organisations incorporated in the Emigrants' Committee having discussed, at their sitting held on June 21, the letter of the Chairman of the Meeting held on June 18 by the representatives of the social organisations, has to state that any attempt at unification which contributes towards the cessation of hostilities, the creation of unanimity among the Russian Emigrants, their organisation and which facilitates the problem of the amelioration of the economic and social status of Russians has always had the sympathetic consideration of the Emigrants' Committee. The organisations incorporated in the Emigrants' Committee have repeatedly made attempts in this direction and even the idea of the creation of the Emigrants' Committee headed by V.F.Grosse, the former Imperial Russian Consul General, aimed at the unification of the Russian Colony around an organisation sufficiently competent to represent the interests of the emigrants residing in Shanghai and always to render help to all Russians in need. At the same time the emigrants' committee, after considering the whole matter, have arrived at the following conclusions:

1. Once more to express their satisfaction, that the idea of bringing about the cessation of the internal strife in the colony and of the necessity to coordinate the work tending to ameliorate the economic and social status, has met with the approval, apparently, of the broad masses of the Russian emigrants community.

2. Moreover, the Emigrants' Committee esteem that this unification should have economic and social character and while being anti-bolshevist in principle, must it must not at the same time join any political group in order not cause a split so that all Russian emigrants may hope to the defense of their interests in an equal degree.

3. In order that the unification may be effective and be of a character that will really contribute towards the realisation of the object put up, it must be grouped round one person who is the leader of the colony. This person must be sufficiently experienced in the relations with foreigners and Chinese in order to be able to put into effect all that is useful to the emigrants.

4. An executive committee, as a consultative organ, may be attached to that person.

5. The only person who possesses all these qualifications as a head of the committee is, in the opinion of the Emigrants' Committee, the former Imperial Russian Consul General V.F.Grosse, who has already received the approval of the Very Reverend Shanghai Bishop, asked to lead Russian emigrants.

4. There exists already a consultative Emigrants' Committee attached to him which has devotedly undertaken the work entrusted to it, and the number of daily applicants to it as well as the amount of correspondence with Chinese and foreign authorities clearly shows that it is being approached by persons belonging to various groups, regardless of their allegiance one or the other political organisation.

6. These two principles, i.e. the unification on a business principle and the massing of the emigrants round one person experienced in dealing with foreign and Chinese authorities, implicate principle of succession of authority, a principle dear to all emigrants. These two principles have already been practically

1925年6月21日上海俄侨委员会会议记录节录译文

加入俄侨委员会的各组织在6月21日的会议上讨论了由社会组织代表于6月18日举行的会议主席的来信，现声明：任何有助于停止敌对行动、在俄侨中建立一致意见、促进其组织化，并有利于改善俄国人经济和社会地位问题的统一尝试，一直得到俄侨委员会的同情考虑。加入俄侨委员会的各组织曾多次朝此方向做出努力，甚至成立以前帝俄总领事 V.F.格罗瑟（V.F.Grosse）为首的俄侨委员会的想法，也是旨在围绕一个有足够能力代表居住在上海的侨民利益并始终向所有有需要的俄国人提供援助的组织，来团结俄侨群体。与此同时，俄侨委员会在审议整个事项后，得出以下结论：

1. 再次表示满意的是，关于停止侨民内部纷争以及协调旨在改善经济和社会地位的工作之必要性的想法，显然得到了广大俄侨群体的认可。

2. 此外，俄侨委员会认为，这种统一应具有经济和社会性质，虽然在原则上是反布尔什维克的，但不得同时加入任何政治团体，以免引起分裂，从而使所有俄侨都能希望同等程度地维护其利益。

3. 为了使统一有效并具有真正有助于实现所提出目标的性质，必须围绕一位作为侨民领袖的人物进行组织。此人必须在与外国人和中国人的关系方面拥有足够的经验，以便能够实施所有对侨民有益的措施。

4. 可以为此人设立一个执行委员会，作为咨询机构。

5. 俄侨委员会认为，唯一具备所有这些资格担任委员会负责人的人，是前帝俄总领事 V.F.格罗瑟，他已得到受邀领导俄侨的上海主教阁下（Very Reverend Shanghai Bishop）的认可。

4. 目前已有附属于他的咨询性俄侨委员会，该委员会忠实地承担了受托的工作，每日向其提出申请的人数以及与中国和外国当局通信的数量清楚地表明，无论其效忠于哪一个政治组织，各类人群均向其寻求帮助。

6. 这两项原则，即基于事务原则的统一，以及将侨民聚集在一位熟悉与中外当局打交道的人士周围，蕴含了权力继承的原则，这是所有侨民珍视的原则。这两项原则实际上已经

page_data.en:
realised by the Emigrants' Committee and the organisations incorpo-
rate therein.

8. Thus the question of unification reduces itself simply to
joining the emigrants committee by all organisations which so far
have kept aloof.

9. The Emigrants' Committee is wholly prepared to give full
consideration to all wishes pertaining to the question of joining
it by representatives of other organisations, but on the unreser-
ved condition of the following principal conditions:
n
a) the united community, while preserving its anti-bolshevist
character, will not join any political group.
b) it must be presided over by V.F.Grosse in his capacity
of former Imperial Russian Consul General.

The Emigrants' Committee, after considering the invitation
to participate in a meeting which is to be held on June 24 and
having heard the information given on this subject by Mr.Chunikhin
and ascertained that the promoters do not possess any clearly
outlined plan of unification, came to the following decision:
To refrain from sending their representative to this meeting
and to send them its views on unification.

8. 因此，统一问题简化为迄今为止保持距离的所有组织加入俄侨委员会。

9. 俄侨委员会完全准备充分考虑其他组织代表关于加入该委员会的所有愿望，但须无条件满足以下主要条件：
a) 联合后的社群在保持其反布尔什维克性质的同时，不加入任何政治团体。
b) 必须由以前帝俄总领事身份任职的 V.F.格罗瑟主持。

俄侨委员会在考虑了参加定于6月24日举行的会议的邀请，并听取了丘尼欣先生（Mr.Chunikhin）就此主题提供的信息，且查明发起者没有任何清晰勾勒的统一计划后，作出如下决定：
不派遣代表参加此次会议，并向他们发送我方关于统一的观点。

Intelligence Report 18625

About 20,000 sick and wounded convalescent soldiers in Nanking are a
continual source of anxiety to both the inhabitants of
the city and the military authorities. On June 16, 400 of these troops
tried to force their way into a cinema theatre and subsequently assaulted
employees of the theatre and the police. General Ho Ying Ching was
notified, but failed to discipline the soldiers who claim credit for the
capture of certain cities in the North. They are now threatening to burn
down the theatre.

Of the 850 Nationalist soldiers, who recently arrived in Shanghai from
Tsingtao and are billeted at the Old Camp, near St. Catherine's Bridge,
30 natives of Shanghai and vicinity were paid off with $1 each at 11 a.m.
June 17. In addition 30 of these troops were taken to the Red Cross
Hospital, Tien Tung An, Chapei by ambulance at 4 p.m. June 17.

Owing to unsatisfactory sanitary and cooking arrangements in the Old
Camp, half of the troops ex Tsingtao who arrived in Shanghai on June 15
were removed to the Five Ming Guild at 5 p.m. June 17. A guard of the 32nd
Army has been placed on both camps.

Ten of the soldiers deserted at Pootung before they were transported
to Nantao. The remainder are protesting against being disbanded and insist
on being sent to Nanking in order to obtain their pay which is ten months'
in arrears. Information from an authentic source indicates that the Nan-
king authorities will finally dispose of the troops as follows: Natives of
Hupeh and Hunan to be sent to Hankow, natives of Anhwei and Northern Kiang-
su to Nanking and those who hail from Chekiang to Hangchow to be disbanded.
The scheme is however being kept secret for fear of the troops rioting.

A meeting attended by 56 representatives of various organizations
in Shanghai, except those represented by Mr. Grosse, was held from 4.30 p.m.
to 6.30 p.m. in the Russian Ex-Officers Club, 275 Avenue Joffre, on June 17.
Capt Fomin, Russian Ex-Naval officer was elected chairman and the audience
was addressed by Mr. Chunihin who stated, inter alia, that owing to a
misunderstanding between the Committee for the Protection of Russian Rights
and Interests, represented by Mr. Ivanov and the Emigrants Committee re-
presented by Mr. Grosse it had been decided to hold this preliminary meeting
in an effort to unify the two organizations. However, as the Emigrants
Committee were not represented, the meeting would be postponed until June
24, and further efforts made to induce the absentees to attend.

南京约有20,000名伤病康复士兵，令该市居民及军事当局持续感到焦虑。6月16日，其中400名士兵试图强行闯入一家电影院，随后袭击了影院员工和警察。何应钦将军虽已获知此事，但未能对声称因攻占北方某些城市而有功的士兵进行纪律处分。目前，这些士兵正威胁要烧毁该电影院。

近期从青岛抵达上海并驻扎在圣凯瑟琳桥（St. Catherine's Bridge）附近旧营房的850名国民革命军士兵中，30名上海及周边籍贯的士兵于6月17日上午11时每人领取1元遣散费后退伍。此外，6月17日下午4时，另有30名士兵由救护车送往闸北天通庵红十字会医院。

由于旧营房的卫生和炊事安排令人不满，6月15日抵沪的原青岛部队中有一半于6月17日下午5时被转移至五明公所。第32军的卫队已部署在这两处营房。

有10名士兵在浦东被运往南市之前开小差。其余士兵抗议被解散，坚持要求前往南京以领取拖欠十个月的军饷。来自可靠渠道的消息表明，南京当局最终将按以下方式处置这些部队：湖北和湖南籍士兵送往汉口，安徽和江苏北部籍士兵送往南京，浙江籍士兵送往杭州予以解散。然而，出于担心士兵暴动，该计划一直保密。

6月17日下午4时30分至6时30分，在上海霞飞路275号俄国前军官俱乐部举行了一次会议，除格罗斯（Grosse）先生所代表的组织外，上海各组织的56名代表出席了会议。俄国前海军军官福明（Fomin）上尉当选为主席，丘尼欣（Chunihin）先生向与会者发表讲话，其间指出，由于伊万诺夫（Ivanov）先生代表的“保护俄国人权利和利益委员会”与格罗斯先生代表的“移民委员会”之间存在误解，决定召开此次预备会议，以期统一这两个组织。然而，由于移民委员会未派代表出席，会议将推迟至6月24日举行，并将进一步努力促使缺席者参会。

The "Shanghai Zarya" of June 7th writes as follows:-

Russian.

Fresh attempts at unification.

（批：D.J. Robertson, Have we any information on this. R.W.）
Lately there has been a lot of discussion amongst the Russian community on the subject of unification of local groups which have been in disagreement all this time. It is reported that foreigners will participate and morally support the unification movement. Also that on Sunday, June 12, a general meeting of emigrants will be held at 3 p.m. at the Town Hall. The idea of the unification is that it will help to improve conditions of life of the emigrants and will raise the prestige of the community. The status of Russians will also improve thereby and it is said that the leading circles of community are in favour of the new scheme.

In the Committee for defence of Russian rights and interests.

Mr. M.I. Affanassieff, who was Secretary of the Committee has resigned a few days ago owing to his having entered into partnership with Mr. Ivanoff in law business. Mr. A.A. Belukovitch has been elected Secretary. The memorandum of adherents of unification under the protection of Grand Duke Nicholas Nikolaevitch has been discussed by the Committee at one of its meetings.

Correspondence from abroad and U.S.S.R.

It is reported that in U.S.S.R. persons who correspond with people living abroad are again coming under suspicion so that prior to delivering a letter to a Soviet citizen received from abroad G.P.U. first makes detective enquiries. This means that care should be taken when writing to relatives in Russia from Shanghai.

The "Russia" of June 7th writes as follows:-

Political.

Death of Chang Tso Lin.

The report of the death of Marshal Chang Tso Lin is a big blow for the Russian emigrants in the North. We are anxious as to the fate of Russian troops in the employ of Marshals Chang Tso Lin and Chang Chun Chang. It is difficult to say what the attitude of the Southerners will be towards them. We have just recently buried Gen. Wrangel who left this earth so unexpectedly as poisoning is suspected and now some mysterious fatal hand has put to death at an opportune time Marshal Chang Tso Lin and Gen. Wu , who have openly declared themselves enemies of Bolshevism. There is no doubt that now the position of Russians in the Chinese Eastern Railway Zone will not be envious and the Reds will not fail to make the best of the new situation. Of course there is still the agreement between Japan and Soviet Russia whereby Japan has promised not to allow any anti-Soviet movement in the Zone and to guard the status quo of Soviet territory and this partly explains why the existence of a Russian military group was not desired in addition to inexplicable failure of Japan to help Marshal Chang in his latest difficulties.

6月7日的《上海曙光报》（Shanghai Zarya）写道：-

俄文。

重新尝试统一。

（批注：D.J. Robertson，我们是否有对此的信息。R.W.）
最近，俄侨社区中就长期以来存在分歧的地方团体统一问题进行了大量讨论。据报道，外国人将参与并从道义上支持统一运动。还据报道，6月12日星期日下午3时将在市政厅举行移民大会。统一的构想是，这将有助于改善移民的生活条件，并提高社区的声望。俄国人的地位也将因此得到改善，据说社区领导层支持这一新方案。

在保护俄国人权利和利益委员会内。

曾任委员会秘书的 M.I. Affanassieff 先生因与 Ivanoff 先生合伙从事法律业务，已于数日前辞职。A.A. Belukovitch 先生当选为秘书。委员会在一次会议上讨论了在大公尼古拉·尼古拉耶维奇庇护下的统一支持者的备忘录。

来自国外和苏联的通信。

据报道，在苏联，与居住在国外的人通信的人再次受到怀疑，因此在将收到自国外的信件交付给苏联公民之前，国家政治保卫总局（G.P.U.）首先进行侦探调查。这意味着从上海写信给在俄罗斯的亲属时应谨慎小心。

6月7日的《俄罗斯报》（Russia）写道：-

政治。

张作霖之死。

张作霖元帅死讯的报道对北方的俄侨是一个巨大打击。我们对受雇于张作霖和张宗昌两位元帅的俄国军队的命运感到担忧。很难说南方人会对他们持何种态度。我们刚刚埋葬了突然离世的弗兰格尔将军，疑似中毒，而现在某只神秘的致命之手又在恰当时机夺去了公开宣布自己为布尔什维克主义敌人的张作霖元帅和吴将军的生命。毫无疑问，现在中东铁路地区俄国人的处境将不容乐观，赤色分子绝不会错过利用这一新局面的机会。当然，日本与苏俄之间仍有协议，日本承诺不允许在该地区进行任何反苏运动，并维护苏俄领土的现状，这部分解释了为何不希望存在俄国军事团体，此外还有日本在张元帅最近遭遇困难时未能提供援助这一令人费解的失败。

The "Shanghai Arya" of June 8th writes as follows:-

Political.

Peng Yu-Hsiang alleged enemy of Bolsheviks;

Peking, 31. Peng Yu Hsiang in a letter to Gen.
Arai of Japan has written the following:-
"I know that in foreign circles I am considered
an agent of the Bolsheviks. I shall not deny it. I have been
receiving large sums of money from Moscow and large quantities
of ammunition with which I started the present campaign.
Moscow sent me instructors and helped me to build up the army;
that is all true. But let it be known to you as I am declaring
it officially that U.S.S.R. and her assistance were necessary
to me in order to strengthen myself only. Also the help of
Moscow was required by me so long as I felt the need and when
I could not do things alone. Moscow was the means to an end.
I could always get rid of Moscow and constantly had that in
view. From now onwards I consider Russian Bolsheviks as my
enemies and if they attempt to spread Bolshevism I shall
adopt serious measures to oppose them."
The future will reveal how sincere Peng's statement
is. It is, however, clear now that the present civil war
has been started in China with the aid of Moscow funds and that
the opinion often expressed by Chang Tso Lin that his
Government was fighting the most fierce enemy of the Bolsheviks
was correct. Peng Yu Hsiang is in a full measure an agent of
the Komintern. Also there remains little doubt that people's
money is taken away for purposes of propaganda and the
maintenance of war in other countries. Thus the upkeep of
war in China requires hundreds of thousands dollars. The
Soviet Government freely provides these funds. It is time
for the Soviet diplomats to realize what they are doing.

6月8日的《上海雅利安报》（Shanghai Arya）写道：-

政治。

彭禹贤被指为布尔什维克的敌人；

北京，31日。彭禹贤在给日本荒井将军的信中写道：-
“我知道在外国圈子里，我被视为布尔什维克的代理人。我不否认这一点。我一直从莫斯科接收巨额资金和大量弹药，并用这些物资发动了目前的战役。莫斯科派来了教官，并帮助我组建军队；这些都是事实。但我要正式声明，让你们知道，苏联及其援助对我而言只是为了加强我自身的力量。此外，只要我觉得有必要且无法独自行动时，我才需要莫斯科的帮助。莫斯科只是达到目的的手段。我随时可以摆脱莫斯科，并且一直以此为目标。从现在起，我将俄国布尔什维克视为我的敌人，如果他们试图传播布尔什维主义，我将采取严厉措施予以反对。”
彭的声明究竟有多真诚，未来将见分晓。然而，目前很清楚的是，中国目前的内战是在莫斯科资金的援助下发动的，而张作霖经常表达的观点，即他的政府正在与布尔什维克最凶恶的敌人作战，是正确的。彭禹贤完全是共产国际的代理人。此外，毫无疑问，人民的钱财被拿走用于在其他国家进行宣传和维护战争。因此，维持在中国的战争需要数十万美元。苏联政府自由地提供这些资金。苏联外交官们是时候意识到他们在做什么了。

The discussion will refer to the meeting in Town Hall
and the attitude of Cossack Union towards it. It is
hoped that all members will attend as the matter is important.

Political.

Important happenings in China.

China is witnessing today the unification attempts
at which have been made since the time of Revolution and
never succeeded. The result of this will be that the
Powers will experience more difficulties to negotiate with
China now than when it was separated into North and South.
The Powers at present are only observers of the happenings
in China whilst Japan is the only really concerned one.

The "Echo" of June 8th writes as follows:-

Russian.

Who are the initiators of unification
here?

Every attempt at unification should be heartily
greeted and supported if its purpose is definite. At
present a persistent rumour has been in circulation amongst
the Russian community regarding a fresh attempt at unification
which is to take place at the general meeting of emigrants
at the Town Hall on June 10 at 3 p.m. The time and place
seem to be definite enough. It is, however, not known
who the initiators of this good cause are. The only thing
known about it is that the initiators have invited
foreigners to attend the meeting. The mystery surrounding
preparations for this meeting and the secrecy with which
the names of initiators are concealed do not permit us to
express our opinion more definitely on the subject. Attempts
of this nature have been numerous and strange to say they
have only resulted in still further disagreement of the
emigrants and the formation of more groups opposed to one
another.

Gen. Horvath's representatives.

Gen. Horvath appointed as his representatives
Mr. A.A. Orloff, elected President of the Russian National
Association in Tientsin and Mr. V.V. Blonsky in Mukden.
The latter has been recognized as senior of the Russian
Community by the Chinese Commissioner for Foreign Affairs
and Mr. Orloff is negotiating with the Chinese Authorities
too having already succeeded in obtaining certain rights
and privileges for Russians.

6月9日的《上海朝霞报》（Shanghai Zarya）写道：-

俄侨。

哥萨克联盟。

鉴于6月10日将在市政厅举行俄侨大会，上海哥萨克联盟委员会邀请其所有成员于6月10日上午9时在霞飞路376号哥萨克联盟办事处开会。讨论将涉及市政厅的会议以及哥萨克联盟对此的态度。希望所有成员出席，因为此事很重要。

政治。

中国的重要事态。

中国今天正见证着自革命以来屡试不成、从未成功的统一尝试。其结果将是，列强现在与中国进行谈判时将比中国分裂为南北两方时面临更多困难。目前列强只是中国事态的旁观者，而日本是唯一真正关切的一方。

6月8日的《回声报》（Echo）写道：-

俄侨。

谁是这里统一运动的发起人？

如果目的明确，每一次统一尝试都应受到热烈欢迎和支持。目前，俄侨社区中流传着一种持久的谣言，称将于6月10日下午3时在市政厅举行的俄侨大会上再次尝试统一。时间和地点似乎已足够确定。然而，尚不清楚这一善举的发起人是谁。关于此事唯一已知的是，发起人已邀请外国人出席会议。围绕此次会议筹备工作的神秘色彩以及对发起人姓名的保密，使我们无法就此问题发表更明确的意见。此类尝试为数众多，奇怪的是，它们只导致了移民之间更严重的分歧，并形成了更多相互对立的团体。

霍尔瓦特将军的代表。

霍尔瓦特将军任命A.A.奥尔洛夫先生（当选为天津俄罗斯国民协会主席）和V.V.布隆斯基先生（在沈阳）为其代表。后者已被中国外交特派员承认为俄侨社区的长者，而奥尔洛夫先生也在与中国当局进行谈判，并已成功为俄国人获得某些权利和特权。

The "Russia" of June 10th writes as follows:-
Russian.
Notification.
The meeting of emigrants to have been held on
June 10 has been postponed to June 17 at 3 p.m. at the

The "Soho "of June 9th writes as follows:-
Russian.
Alleged initiators of the emigrants
meeting.
It is alleged that Messrs Chunihin and Matrosoff
are the initiators of the proposed meeting of emigrants.
Benevolence and split in the Russian
Community.
The split amongst the public organizations in
the Russian community is the greatest evil for the emigrants.
The Russian well to do section of the community busy with
its own interests pays no attention to the rest of the
community. Moreover, strange as it is, benevolent
work of Russian organizations is based entirely on assistance
from foreigners, which state of affairs cannot continue for
ever. The numerous Russian concerns, shops, offices,
pharmacies etc., which mostly have Russian customers should
be able to organize Russian benevolence to their fellow-
citizens. On the other hand the large number of public
organizations with high flown titles, rules and regulations
of various description, cannot either be recognized as
an organized body able to help their own community. This
for the most part is a disorganized element although there
are a few organizations which quietly but persistently
come to the assistance of the destitute and turn nobody away
from their doors. The several attempts at reconciliation
and re-union of the Russian community members have never
given any good results. The trouble is that the failure
comes not from want of reconciliation, but because all the
attempts had their beginning from the very source which
previously caused the disagreements. For example the letter
of Russian women is excellent but even here they refuse
to submit their will and acknowledge for instance that in
the church dispute question they were wrong and wish to
repent. Instead of that they stated that this a question
of everybody's conscience and the same excuse may be applied
to all other quarrels. One has to adopt a different spirit
in the whole matter and try and reach some real understanding
so that each one may do some good in the general cause.
Soviet.
Who finances British communists?
The Central Communist Party declares that the
British section being part of the International Organization
pays in a certain sum to the centre and is in return supported
by the latter.

俄侨。
通知。

6月9日的《索霍报》（Soho）写道：-
俄侨。
据称的移民会议发起人。
据称，丘尼欣先生和马特罗索夫先生是拟议中的移民会议的发起人。
俄侨社区的慈善与分裂。
俄侨社区公共组织之间的分裂是移民面临的最大祸害。社区中富裕的俄国人忙于自身利益，不关注社区的其他人。此外，奇怪的是，俄国组织的慈善工作完全基于外国人的援助，这种状况不可能永远持续下去。众多的俄国商行、商店、办公室、药店等，其主要客户多为俄国人，本应能够组织起来向其同胞提供慈善援助。另一方面，大量拥有冠冕堂皇的头衔、各种规章制度的公共组织，也不能被视为一个能够帮助自己社区的有组织团体。这在很大程度上是一个无组织的要素，尽管有少数组织默默无闻但坚持不懈地援助贫困者，从不拒人于门外。几次调和及重新团结俄侨社区成员的尝试从未取得任何良好结果。问题在于，失败并非由于缺乏和解意愿，而是因为所有尝试都源于此前导致分歧的同一源头。例如，俄国妇女的信写得很好，但即使在这里，她们也拒绝服从大局，并承认比如在教堂争端问题上她们错了并希望悔改。相反，她们声称这是每个人的良心问题，同样的借口也可适用于所有其他争吵。必须在整个事件中采取不同的态度，努力达成某种真正的谅解，以便每个人都能为共同事业做些好事。
苏维埃。
谁资助英国共产党人？
中央共产党宣布，英国分部作为国际组织的一部分，向中心缴纳一定金额，并反过来得到后者的支持。

The "Echo" of June 11th writes as follows:- (Afternoon translation).
Russian.
Trouble in the Editorial Offices of the "Russia".
Various rumours are in circulation amongst the Russian
community about the disagreement which occurred between leaders
of the newspaper "Russia". On Friday the newspaper was published
without a leading article and on Saturday it was not distributed
at all although published. The cause of the trouble originated
on account of the proposed meeting in the Town Hall. Mr.
Kolesnikoff, ex editor of the paper, wrote a leading article
very much against the meeting at Town Hall. Mr. Oganezoff,
representative of the Editorial Collective and the "censor" of
the publication, did not publish the above leading article. The
next day he wrote his own article on the subject supporting the
idea of the meeting. Having learnt of this Mr. Kolesnikoff
went to the printing offices with a view to protesting, but six
men on guard did not let Kolesnikoff in. He then appealed to
the "Editorial Collective" and obtained permission from the latter
to call a policeman to the scene of trouble. The offices were
closed and the printing of the paper discontinued. A few printed
numbers of the paper with the article in question were, however,
taken away from the offices in time.
It is not known how the trouble will end, but there is
a rumour to the effect that the "Editorial Collective" decided to
take away from Mr. Oganezoff the direct management of the paper
and to appoint another person for this post. Mr. Oganezoff is
not willing to relinquish his post so easily and refuses to
accept his dismissal in favour of someone else. The owners of
the newspaper "Russia" are the Collective and the Printing
Offices as per agreement made with Mr. Kolesnikoff.
Soviet.
A satire on Soviet citizens.
A satire in the form of a letter to an aunt in Soviet
Russia by a Soviet citizen in Shanghai is written wherein the
Soviet citizen describes his hardships of living here and parti-
cularly how he has to escape being deported for falling into any
disgrace with the Municipal Police.
The "Russia" of June 12th writes as follows:-
Russian.
Refutation.
The article published in No.136 of the newspaper
"Echo" entitled "Trouble in the Editorial Offices of the "Russia""
is mere gossip and has no foundation. Mr. Kolesnikoff has not
been to the Editorial Offices during the past 3 months as there
was nothing for him to do there. The Police did not seal the
offices and the newspaper was printed all the time. Mr. Oganezoff
is not a "censor" of the newspaper "Russia". No articles were
published with reference to the meeting, except the usual
official advertisement of the Initiative Group.

6月11日的《回声报》写道：-（午后译稿）。
俄侨。
《俄罗斯报》编辑部的纠纷。
俄侨社区中流传着各种关于《俄罗斯报》领导人之间发生分歧的谣言。周五该报出版时没有社论，周六虽然出版但未发行。纠纷的起因在于拟议在市政厅举行的会议。该报前编辑科列斯尼科夫先生写了一篇强烈反对市政厅会议的社论。编辑部集体代表兼出版物“审查员”奥加涅佐夫先生未刊登上述社论。次日，他就此主题撰写了自己的文章，支持会议的想法。科列斯尼科夫先生得知此事后，前往印刷厂提出抗议，但六名守卫人员不让科列斯尼科夫进入。随后他向“编辑部集体”申诉，并获得后者许可，叫警察到纠纷现场。办事处被关闭，报纸印刷停止。然而，几份印有争议文章的已印报纸及时从办事处被带走。
目前尚不知纠纷将如何结束，但有谣言称，“编辑部集体”决定剥夺奥加涅佐夫先生对报纸的直接管理权，并任命另一人担任此职。奥加涅佐夫先生不愿轻易放弃职位，拒绝接受被解职并由他人接替。根据与科列斯尼科夫先生达成的协议，《俄罗斯报》的所有者是集体和印刷厂。
苏维埃。
对苏维埃公民的讽刺。
一篇以在上海的苏维埃公民写给其在苏俄的姨妈的信的形式写成的讽刺文章，其中描述了他在上海生活的艰辛，特别是他如何不得不逃避因得罪工部局警务处而被驱逐出境。
6月12日的《俄罗斯报》写道：-
俄侨。
驳斥。
《回声报》第136号刊登的题为“《俄罗斯报》编辑部的纠纷”的文章纯属流言蜚语，毫无根据。科列斯尼科夫先生在过去3个月内未曾去过编辑部，因为那里没有他要做的事。警察并未查封办事处，报纸一直在印刷。奥加涅佐夫先生不是《俄罗斯报》的“审查员”。除发起小组的常规官方广告外，未刊登任何有关会议的文章。

The "Shanghai Zarya" of June 12th writes as follows:-
Russian.
Cossacks' Union on Unification.
On June 1, a meeting of members of the Cossacks' Union
in Shanghai was held under the chairmanship of Mr. I.M.
Mendrikoff at the offices of the Committee for Defence of Russian
Rights. The matter discussed at the meeting referred to the
proposed general meeting of Russian emigrants with a view to
unification. Members of the Cossacks' Union whilst recognizing
in principle the absolute necessity of unification of Russian
emigrants in Shanghai nevertheless does not consider it possible
to attain through the medium of a general meeting and for these
reasons: As well as the meeting may be organized it is not
likely to be complete; some may come and others not and those
belonging to the latter category will have a right to dispute
the decisions of the first meeting and demand the convocation of
a second one. The public opinion will thus be centred again on
the general disagreement, when some will recognize individual
meetings as lawful and others unlawful, thereby giving the
Bolsheviks a chance to rejoice. Even a well organized meeting
can always be disputed and persons displeased with decisions
reached will cause trouble inspired thereto by the Bolsheviks.
The main question is whether with the assistance of
the proposed meeting at the Town Hall it will be possible to
do away with all existing disagreements and elect a new committee
to replace all the present ones functioning under the protection
of the Committee for Defence of Russian Rights and the Emigrants'
Committee. The majority of Russian community will not be
present at the general meeting if but for one reason and that
is the insufficiency of Town Hall to hold them all. It is
difficult in Shanghai to learn the will of the emigrants even
by means of balloting. In view of the existing conditions in
order to attain real unification of Russian emigrants it is
necessary to have preliminary negotiations and agreement reached
between all organizations not recognizing the Soviet Government
in Shanghai and then a committee should be formed from amongst
representatives of these organizations and individuals commanding
great esteem in the community which would arrange either a
system of balloting or the holding of district meetings in Shanghai
In both cases the procedure should be based on the customary
principles viz: limit of age for the voters, political security
etc. etc. But to convene a meeting without any preliminary
preparation and expect an end to disagreements is extremely naive.
The meeting convened as proposed by the initiative
group, consisting of several little or not known persons, may be
attended by Soviet agents in any number who, under the guise of
emigrants, might provoke the attendance and thereby lower again
the prestige of Russian community. Such methods as provocation
and incitement are detrimental to the unification of true nature
of the Russian emigrants in Shanghai. Foreigners who desire to
help the unification cannot rely on a casual meeting and see in it
the expression of the will of the entire emigration.
The Cossacks' Union is of the opinion that at the
present time of responsibility and historical significance in
the life of the Far East it is especially necessary to take great
care against irresponsible actions of individuals, whose
intentions may be good, but who fail to understand the possible
consequences of their rash activities.
This is the opinion of the Cossacks' Union on the
matter of unification.

6月12日的《上海扎里亚报》（Shanghai Zarya）写道：——
俄文。
哥萨克联盟关于统一问题。
6月1日，在上海俄国权利保护委员会办公室，由 I.M. 门德里科夫（I.M. Mendrikoff）先生主持召开了上海哥萨克联盟成员会议。会议讨论的事项涉及拟议中的俄国侨民大会，旨在实现统一。哥萨克联盟成员虽然在原则上承认上海俄国侨民统一的绝对必要性，但并不认为通过召开全体大会的方式能够实现这一目标，理由如下：无论会议组织得多么周密，都不太可能做到全员出席；有些人会来，有些人不会来，而那些属于后一类的人将有权质疑第一次会议的决定，并要求召开第二次会议。公众舆论将再次集中于普遍的分歧之上，一些人承认个别会议的合法性，而另一些人则不承认，从而使布尔什维克有可乘之机而窃喜。即使是组织良好的会议也总是可能受到质疑，而对已达成的决定不满的人会在布尔什维克的煽动下制造麻烦。主要问题在于，借助于在市议会大厅（Town Hall）召开的拟议会议，是否有可能消除所有现存的分歧，并选举一个新的委员会来取代目前在俄国权利保护委员会和侨民委员会庇护下运作的所有现有委员会。如果仅因一个原因，即市议会大厅不足以容纳所有人，那么大多数俄国社群成员将不会出席这次全体大会。在上海，即使通过投票表决的方式，也很难了解侨民的意愿。鉴于目前的状况，为了实现俄国侨民的真正统一，有必要在上海所有不承认苏维埃政府的组织之间进行初步谈判并达成协议，然后由这些组织的代表以及在社群中享有崇高声望的个人组成一个委员会，该委员会将安排要么实行投票制度，要么在上海举行分区会议。在这两种情况下，程序都应基于惯常原则，即：选民的年龄限制、政治可靠性等等。但是，在没有任何初步准备的情况下召开会议，并期望结束分歧，是极其天真的。
由几个鲜为人知或完全不知名的人组成的发起小组所召集的会议，可能会有大量苏维埃代理人参加，他们伪装成侨民，可能会挑衅与会者，从而再次降低俄国社群的威望。诸如挑衅和煽动之类的手段，不利于上海俄国侨民本质上的真正统一。希望帮助统一的外国人不能依赖一次偶然的会议，并将其视为整个侨民群体意志的表达。
哥萨克联盟认为，在远东生活处于责任重大且具有历史意义的当前时刻，特别需要警惕个人的不负责任行为，这些人的意图可能是好的，但他们未能理解其鲁莽活动可能带来的后果。
以上是哥萨克联盟关于统一问题的意见。

The "Shanghai Arya" of June 15th writes as follows:-

Russian.

Statement of the Committee for Defence of
Russian Rights and Interests.

Whilst welcoming the idea of the initiative group to

Chairman of the Committee for Defence

Shanghai.
J. Domracheff,
Representative for the Far East and

Russian Patriotic Unification Abroad

6月15日的《上海雅利安报》（Shanghai Arya）写道：——

俄文。

俄国权利与利益保护委员会声明。

虽然欢迎发起小组为谋求统一而召开上海俄国社群全体大会的想法，但隶属于上海俄国权利与利益保护委员会、远东君主主义组织委员会以及海外俄国爱国统一会的各组织，在收到 D.L. 霍尔瓦特（D.L. Horvath）中将的指示之前，不能参加全体侨民会议。上述两个组织和发起小组均已通过电报请求霍尔瓦特将军就此事项发表意见，因为此次会议最初是在未经霍尔瓦特将军授权的情况下召集的。

N. A. 伊万诺夫（N. A. Ivanoff），

Translation from the "Shanghai Arya" continued (Afternoon).
Political.
America and happenings in China.
There is no doubt that the part of America in present
Chinese happenings is quite great. The American press often
commented that the United States with respect to China should
maintain either an independent policy or at least a leading one
rather than follow in the footsteps of British and Japanese
diplomacy. This policy of America dictated by the centre
in the opinion of adherents of activity causes an irreparable
detriment to the American prestige and in the eyes of the
educated Chinese society America has not got her own face.
America, with all her passiveness, cannot allow Japan to make
use of the present happenings so as to obtain special rights
and privileges in Shantung. Of course the co-operation of the
Powers in the Far East means peace, whilst dissension will sooner
or later lead to a war. American influence in China is very
extensive, but Americans themselves admit that they have failed
to make the best of their influence because of the existing
tendency to co-operate with the other interested Powers. Thus
America has gained nothing, but rather to the contrary as
Great Britain and Japan are foremost now, the one for having
successfully emerged out of a serious crisis and the other
for being very active and decisive. There is reason to believe
that in a short time we may witness a change in the policy of
America in China.
The "Echo" of June 15th continued:-
More on Russian Unification.
In connection with the excellent article published by
the "North China Daily News" a few days ago enumerating the merits
of the Russian community in Shanghai with regard to their local
achievements, etc. It may be said that the failure of fresh
attempts at unification lies not so much in the constant disputes
prevailing amongst members of the community and its organizations,
but the fact that political motives are again laid as the
foundation for unification. In one of our recent articles on
the growth and prosperity of the Russian community we emphasized
that a great deal of the success should be attributed to the
attention and assistance given to Russians by the authorities of
French Concession and of the International Settlement. It should
be understood that if we fail to attain peace and good order
of a local nature amongst ourselves there is little hope that
we shall ever restore Russia to her former glory.

《上海雅利安报》译文续（下午版）。
政治。
美国与中国局势。
毫无疑问，美国在当前中国局势中所扮演的角色相当重要。美国媒体经常评论称，美国对华应保持独立政策，或至少保持主导政策，而不是追随英国和日本外交的脚步。这种由中心 dictated 的美国政策，在活动支持者看来，给美国的威望造成了不可弥补的损害，在受过教育的中国社会眼中，美国没有自己的面目。尽管美国表现得如此被动，但它不能允许日本利用当前局势在山东获取特殊权利和特权。当然，列强在远东的合作意味着和平，而分歧迟早会导致战争。美国在中国的影响力非常广泛，但美国人自己承认，由于存在与其他利益相关列强合作的倾向，他们未能充分利用其影响力。因此，美国一无所获，反而适得其反，因为英国和日本现在处于领先地位，前者是因为成功摆脱了严重危机，后者是因为非常积极和果断。有理由相信，在不久的将来，我们可能会见证美国对华政策的转变。

The "Shanghai Arya" of June 19th. writes as follows:-
Russian.
Preliminary meeting of representatives of
public organizations re unification.

The attempt of the initiative group to unify Russian
emigrants has had its first success last Sunday in the form of
a preliminary meeting attended by delegates of various public
organizations. There were 49 representatives on behalf of 31
organizations. Mr. N. J. Fomin presided over the meeting and
Mr. Chunihin was the first speaker. He informed the audience that
a day prior to this meeting viz Saturday he visited Mr. V.
Grosse, Chairman of the Russian migrants' Committee, and conversed
on the subject of the unification when Mr. Grosse assured him
that the idea of unification was welcome to him and he would
support it. With regard to the sending of delegates representing
the Emigrants' Committee and other organizations Mr. Grosse
said that he could not do that until a meeting of the Committee
is convened to discuss the question of the meeting.
In reviewing the work of the initiative group, Mr.
Chunihin stated that although there are two distinct organizations
representing the Russian emigrants in Shanghai there is no
real unity and co-operation. Whilst preparing the general
meeting, he said, all public organizations were approached and
as a result of different opinions obtained and the impression
prevailing that the convention of a meeting as proposed is too
premature, the initiative group postponed it. It then became
known that the Committee for Defense of Russian Rights and
Interests cannot take part in the meeting without the sanction
of Gen. Horvath first had and obtained. A telegram received
from Gen. Horvath led to the decision of postponing the meeting
to a still later date so as to give time and chance to different
organizations to come to some understanding and thus prevent
further disagreements. Careful preparations will frustrate any
attempts on the part of certain elements to cause trouble
amongst the community. In replying to questions asked by
the audience Mr. Chunihin gave details on interviews had with
Mr. Grosse and added that a reply re delegates was expected this
week from the Emigrants' Committee.
Mr. N.J. Fomin after calling upon the attendance to
discuss matters brought forward by Mr. Chuninin requests Gen.
Affanassieff to speak.
Gen. Affanassieff says:- "The task of to-day's meeting
is to express our opinions on ways and means to unite Russians
in Shanghai under one powerful organization authorized to act
on our behalf. It would be impossible to deal with this question
at a general meeting whilst a totally different result can be
obtained through the appointment of a special commission which
would work out the programme and then present it to the public
for approval or otherwise. Previous experience in such matters
shows that should we all meet to-day to discuss the proposed
plan differences of opinion, disagreements etc., would crop up
and being of minor importance would spoil the entire scheme.
Therefore the appointment of a commission is imperative and
its findings should be presented at the general meeting at the
Town Hall. That meeting should be carried out in a
smooth way as we would then be parading before foreigners and
it is not desirable that they should be faced with internal
disputes and misunderstandings.
The next speaker is Mr. N.A. Ivanow who brings forth
the question of the lawfulness of the meeting held. He asks:
"Can we consider our meeting as lawful to decide the question

The "Shanghai Mercury" of June 24th writes as follows:-
russian.

ways and means towards unification.

The emigrants of Shanghai have been unexpectedly
faced with the problem of unification at a short notice. Although
we are very much for unification it seems to us that if an
"urgent" unification did not take place during the circumstances
of March 1927 it is not likely to materialize at one meeting
held at the Town Hall now. It would be far better to get
Gen. Horvath, whose authority we are all inclined to recognize,
to send his representative here with the necessary authorizations
to Chinese authorities so that he could take upon himself the
registration and protection of emigrants. However happenings
in Peking have altered the position of Gen. Horvath. He
negotiated with the Northern Government and it is not yet known
what his relations with the new authorities will be. Therefore
the decision of the Russian problem in China will take a longer
time than expected. In the meantime if the Russian emigrants
in Shanghai really want to unite they should do this by
means of the voicing of opinion by the majority of Russians here.
This can be carried out only by voting and would be the best
means in the eyes of the foreigners as it would show who is
really for or against the unification. If there are six or
seven thousand voices in favour of certain people to be at
the head of the Russian community in Shanghai, this would
be considered as an organized public opinion and our representa-
tives will have been chosen by the majority of the Russian
residents in Shanghai. Hurried attempts by persons with the
best of their good-will, however, cannot help the cause and
under the circumstances it seems best to maintain the position
of "medium peace" rather then face a new and definite split.

The "Echo" of June 29th writes as follows:-
soviet.

Moscow's help to Feng.

A conference was held at Irkutsk (Siberia) under
the chairmanship of Potin, Commander in Chief of the Siberian
Military Area, and attended by the Commanders of the 18th and
19th Corps. The discussion concerned events in China. It was
decided to give assistance to Feng Yu Hsiang for whom 4 trans-
ports of ammunition of various description have already been
despatched to Ulan-Bator from Verkhne-Udinsk via Troitsko-Savsk.
In addition to above 6 more transports are being in preparation
for despatch to Bao-Tou, interior Mongolia.

Fate of Russian emigrants.

Remoff, a Soviet writer in Moscow, published a
pamphlet on the question of Russian emigrants wherein he
expressed the opinion that the growing generation of Russians
educated in foreign schools will gradually lose their antagonism
to Soviet Russia as they will have become more foreignized
and will not entertain the same feelings of hostility that
their fathers and forefathers have. There are two generations
amongst emigration speaking in two different languages. Thus
towards the forties in Europe emigration will no longer represent
a threat to Soviet Russia. The same does not apply altogether
to emigrants in the Far East as they are more closely connected
with Russia, are more prosperous and united.

6月24日的《上海泰晤士报》（Shanghai Mercury）写道：-
俄语。

统一的途径和方法。

上海侨民 unexpectedly 面临着一个短时间内提出的统一问题。虽然我们非常支持统一，但在我们看来，如果在1927年3月的情况下未能实现“紧急”统一，那么现在在市政厅举行的一次会议上也不太可能实现。更好的办法是让霍尔瓦特将军（Gen. Horvath）——其权威我们都倾向于承认——派遣一名拥有必要授权的代表前来中国当局，以便由其承担侨民的登记和保护工作。然而，北京的事态改变了霍尔瓦特将军的地位。他曾与北方政府进行谈判，目前尚不清楚他与新当局的关系如何。因此，在中国解决俄国问题所需的时间将比预期的更长。与此同时，如果上海的俄国侨民真的希望团结，他们应该通过此处大多数俄国人发表意见的方式来实现这一点。这只能通过投票来进行，在外国人眼中这将是最好的手段，因为它将显示谁真正支持或反对统一。如果有六千或七千张选票支持某些人担任上海俄国社区的领袖，这将被视为一种有组织的公众舆论，而我们的代表也将由上海大多数俄国居民选出。然而，怀着最大善意的人们的仓促尝试无助于事业，在这种情况下，似乎最好保持“中等和平”的立场，而不是面对新的、明确的分裂。

6月29日的《回声报》（Echo）写道：-
苏维埃。

莫斯科对冯玉祥的援助。

在西伯利亚伊尔库茨克举行了一次会议，由西伯利亚军区司令波廷（Potin）主持，第18和第19军军团长出席。讨论涉及中国的事态。决定向冯玉祥提供援助，为此已从上乌丁斯克（Verkhne-Udinsk）经特罗伊茨科萨夫斯克（Troitsko-Savsk）向乌兰巴托发送了4批各种类型的弹药运输队。除上述之外，另有6批运输队正在准备发往内蒙古包头。

俄国侨民的命运。

莫斯科的苏维埃作家雷莫夫（Remoff）出版了一本关于俄国侨民问题的小册子，其中表达了一种观点，即在外国学校受教育的增长中的一代俄国人将逐渐失去对苏维埃俄国的敌意，因为他们将变得更加外国化，并且不会怀有其父辈和祖辈那样的敌对情绪。侨民中有两代人使用两种不同的语言。因此，到了四十年代，欧洲的侨民将不再代表对苏维埃俄国的威胁。同样的情况并不完全适用于远东的侨民，因为他们与俄国联系更紧密，更富裕且更团结。

The "Shanghai Surya" of June 23rd writes as follows:-
Political.
Chang-Tso-Lin.
The death of Chang Tso Lin is a great loss to all
Russians of the three eastern provinces and one to be regretted
by the whole civilized world for he did all in his power to
save China from the wave of Red revolution and Russians under
his rule were able to live and work peacefully. Chang Tso Lin's
name will go down in the history of China as that of a hero
who fell a victim to communism. In this respect Chang Tso Lin
has shared the fate of Admiral Kolchak, in whose personality
Marshal Chang was always interested. Both the death of
Admiral Kolchak and the fact that the outcome did not support
Chang Tso Lin will remain on the conscience of the White
International which does not seem to see yet that the world
is threatened with when the hour of general revolutionary strikes.
The "Echo" of June 22nd writes as follows:-
Russian.
Migrants' Committee against
sending of delegates.
The Migrants' Committee at a meeting held yesterday
and attended by representatives of different organizations
adhering to it, decided not to send its delegates to the
preliminary meeting of delegates of public organizations
to be convened at the Officers' Club on Sunday. The refusal
was based on the fact that once before there was an attempt
to attain unification on similar lines and it ended in big
trouble. The present Migrants' Committee formed at that
"meeting of unification" caused the split and some of the
organizations which participated in its formation refused
to submit to it later on. Therefore there is no guarantee
that the same thing will happen again. Dr. Chunihin, who was
invited to attend the meeting of the Migrants' Committee,
when explaining the matter was unable to tell by what means
he expects to carry out his plans of unification.
A novel occupation.
A certain Russian named Zavaroff, who speaks fluent
Japanese, claiming that he is a detective of the international
settlement police and an interpreter to the Japanese naval
authorities has been buying things in Japanese shops on credit.
It has now been ascertained that Zavaroff does not hold any
of the above mentioned positions and therefore merchants are
warned against giving him goods on credit.
Soviet.
According to the declaration made by the Executive
Committee of the Bolsheviks the economic state of Russia
has been ruined as a result of the crimes and lack of morals
of the Communists. Nothing has been achieved during the ten
years of revolution to improve the state of the country, but
to-day it represents a scene of destruction.

6月23日的《上海 Surya》报写道：-
政治。
张作霖。
张作霖之死对所有东三省俄国人来说是一个巨大损失，也是整个文明世界所痛惜的，因为他竭尽全力使中国免受赤色革命浪潮的冲击，且在其统治下的俄国人得以和平生活与工作。张作霖的名字将作为中国历史上的一位英雄而载入史册，他是共产主义的牺牲品。在这方面，张作霖的命运与高尔察克海军上将相同，张元帅一直对高尔察克其人颇感兴趣。高尔察克海军上将之死，以及列强未予支持张作霖这一事实，都将留在“白色国际”的良心上，该组织似乎尚未看清当总罢工和全面革命时刻来临时世界所面临的威胁。

6月22日的《回声报》（Echo）写道：-
俄国。
侨民委员会反对
派遣代表。
侨民委员会在昨日举行的会议上，有隶属于该委员会的各不同组织的代表出席，决定不派遣其代表参加将于周日在军官俱乐部召开的公共组织代表预备会议。拒绝的理由是，此前曾有过一次试图以类似方式实现统一的尝试，结果导致了巨大的麻烦。当时在那次“统一会议”上成立的现侨民委员会造成了分裂，一些参与其组建的组织后来拒绝服从它。因此，无法保证同样的事情不会再次发生。受邀出席侨民委员会会议的丘尼欣博士（Dr. Chunihin）在解释此事时，未能说明他期望通过何种手段来执行其统一计划。

一种新奇的职业。
一名名叫扎瓦罗夫（Zavaroff）的俄国人，声称自己是公共租界警务处的侦探及日本海军当局的翻译，能说流利的日语，一直在日本商店赊购商品。现已查明，扎瓦罗夫并不担任上述任何职务，因此警告商人们不要向他赊销货物。

苏维埃。
根据布尔什维克执行委员会发表的声明，由于共产党人的罪行和道德沦丧，俄国的经济状况已被摧毁。在十年的革命期间，没有任何成就来改善国家状况，如今该国呈现出一片毁灭的景象。

The "Soho" of June 23rd writes as follows:-

Russian.

Foreign Friends wish to unite emigrants.

To-morrow the meeting to be held by the Russian
representatives of public organizations in connection with
the proposed meeting at the Town Hall will take place at the
Russian Officers' Club to continue the discussion of
matters appertaining to unification.
As already reported yesterday the Emigrants'
Committee decided against sending its delegates to the
meeting as well as participating in any other way in the
discussion of the question.
It is interesting to note certain explanations
given by Mr. Chunihin to the Emigrants' Committee on the
subject. When asked as to what was the motive which
inspired Mr. Chunihin to take up the question of Russian
emigrants unification, which has failed to be attained
by Gen. Horvath and representatives of Russian Public
Organizations, Mr. Chunihin stated that the matter was
taken up by foreign friends married to Russians. These
foreigners under the pressure of their wives and Russian
women-friends are seriously concerned about the question(!)
Speaking of practical plans whereby unification
in his opinion could be attained, Mr. Chunihin said that
a third committee could be formed in addition to the two
already in existence!

俄国。

通知。

6月24日下午4时，将在军官俱乐部继续举行由公共组织召开的会议，讨论上海俄裔社区统一问题。

6月23日的《Soho》报写道：-

俄国。

外国友人希望团结移民。

明天，俄国公共组织代表将在俄国军官俱乐部举行会议，就拟议在市政厅举行的会议相关事宜，继续讨论有关统一的事项。
正如昨天报道的那样，侨民委员会决定不派遣代表参加会议，也不以任何其他方式参与该问题的讨论。
值得注意的是，丘尼欣先生（Mr. Chunihin）向侨民委员会就此问题给出的一些解释。当被问及是何动机促使丘尼欣先生着手处理俄国移民统一问题时——该问题此前由霍尔瓦特将军（Gen. Horvath）及俄国公共组织代表着手但未能实现——丘尼欣先生称，此事是由嫁给俄国人的外国友人发起的。这些外国人在其妻子和俄国女性朋友的压力下，对此事深感关切（！）
谈到他认为可以实现统一的具体计划时，丘尼欣先生说，除了现有的两个委员会外，还可以成立第三个委员会！

The "Shanghai Times" of June 24th writes as follows:-
Russian.
Meeting of representatives of organisations.
At 1 p.m. to-day the adjourned meeting of
representatives of Russian organizations together with
members of the initiative group will be held at the
Russian Officers' Club with a view to finding ways and
means to unify the local Russian emigrants.
Last week's meeting was adjourned because the
Russian Emigrants' Committee had not sent its delegates. A
resolution was passed then by the meeting to request the
Emigrants' Committee to send delegates to to-day's meeting
so as to discuss the problem of unification jointly and
in a friendly spirit. However there does not seem to be
any chances for such. Mr. V. F. Grosse in a letter addressed
in the name of the Emigrants' Committee to Mr. A. J. Fomin,
presiding over the meeting stated that he intends to refrain
from sending his delegates to to-day's meeting for the
reasons that the initiative group has no definite views
as to how the unification can be carried out. Moreover
Mr. Grosse's letter contains several interesting suggestions
as to how the Emigrants' Committee thinks the desired
unification of Russian community could be attained. The
letter will be read out at the meeting to-day. In the
circles of the Committee for Defence of Russian Rights and
Interests there still prevails a strong desire to attain
the purpose of unification in spite of all difficulties
in the way.

6月24日的《字林西报》（Shanghai Times）写道：-
俄国。
各组织代表会议。
今天下午1时，俄国组织代表与发起小组成员的续会将在俄国军官俱乐部举行，旨在寻找统一当地俄国移民的方法和途径。
上周的会议因俄国侨民委员会未派遣代表而休会。当时会议通过了一项决议，请求侨民委员会派遣代表参加今天的会议，以便共同并友好地讨论统一问题。然而，这似乎没有任何可能。V. F. 格罗斯先生（Mr. V. F. Grosse）以侨民委员会的名义致信会议主席 A. J. 福明先生（Mr. A. J. Fomin），表示他打算不派遣代表参加今天的会议，理由是发起小组对于如何实施统一没有明确的观点。此外，格罗斯先生的信中包含了几项有趣的建议，阐述了侨民委员会认为如何实现俄裔社区所需之统一。该信件将在今天的会议上宣读。尽管面临重重困难，在捍卫俄国权利和利益委员会的圈子里，实现统一的愿望依然强烈。

The "Russia" of June 26th writes as follows:-
Russian.
Second meeting of public organizations
of Shanghai.
The meeting is opened at 4.40 p.m. by A. J. Fomin.
47 representatives of different organizations of Shanghai
are present. The following letter from Mr. Pomadaeff,
Chairman of the Monarchistic Organizations for the Far East and
Abroad, addressed to the Chairman of the meeting, is read:-
"Owing to illness I am unable to be present at to-day's
meeting. In my opinion the attitude of the Emigrants'
Committee which has expressed itself anti- Grand Duke Nikolai
Nikolaevitch and General Horvath as well as the idea of
unification, should not prevent Russian emigrants from
getting united just the same." Then the letter addressed
to Mr. V. I. Grosse by the meeting held on June 17th is read:-
"Dear Victor Fedorovitch, The meeting of represen-
tatives of public organizations of Shanghai, convened by
an initiative group to hold a General Meeting of the Russian
Community and which took place on June 17, has resolved to
inform you of the following:- The meeting has agreed that
in principle the unification of Russian community is very
important and should be decided upon urgently. In view of
the absence at the meeting of representatives from the
Emigrants' Committee and other organizations subject to it,
the meeting resolved to adjourn further discussion of the
question to June 24, 4 p.m. in order that the Emigrants'
Committee and other organizations may send their representatives
to attend it duly authorised. The meeting decided to request
you to inform the Chairman not later than June 22 of the
decision reached by the Emigrants' Committee in the matter.
A. N. Fomin, Chairman of the meeting of representatives of
public organizations in Shanghai; Secretary: A. Biulkevitch
and Chairman of the Initiative Group: Shunin."
Here follows the reading of a reply from Mr. V. I.
Gross, together with the resolutions passed by the Emigrants'
Committee:-
"Having discussed at a meeting held on June 21
the contents of the letter of the Chairman of the Meeting
of Representatives of Public Organizations dated June 18,
organizations functioning under the leadership of the
Emigrants' Committee are of the opinion that every attempt
at unification directed towards the cessation of disagreement
amongst Russians and the attainment of better understanding
between them, all of which would result in the improvement of
economic and political status of Russians has always been
looked upon with approval by the Emigrants' Committee.

6月26日的《俄罗斯》报（Russia）写道：-
俄国。
上海公共组织第二次会议。
会议由 A. J. 福明（A. J. Fomin）于下午4时40分宣布开幕。
来自上海各不同组织的47名代表出席。宣读了远东及海外君主主义组织主席波马达耶夫先生（Mr. Pomadaeff）致会议主席的信，内容如下：
“因病我无法出席今天的会议。在我看来，侨民委员会所持的反尼古拉·尼古拉耶维奇大公（Grand Duke Nikolai Nikolaevitch）和霍尔瓦特将军（General Horvath）的态度，以及其统一理念，不应阻碍俄国移民同样实现团结。” 随后宣读了6月17日会议致 V. I. 格罗斯先生（Mr. V. I. Grosse）的信：
“亲爱的维克多·费奥多罗维奇（Victor Fedorovitch），由发起小组召集以举行俄裔社区全体大会、并于6月17日召开的上海公共组织代表会议，决议通知您以下事项：会议原则上同意，俄裔社区的统一非常重要，应紧急予以决定。鉴于侨民委员会及其下属其他组织的代表缺席会议，会议决定将此问题的进一步讨论推迟至6月24日下午4时，以便侨民委员会及其他组织派遣正式授权的代表出席。会议决定请您在6月22日之前，将侨民委员会就此事项作出的决定通知主席。
上海公共组织代表会议主席：A. N. 福明（A. N. Fomin）；秘书：A. 比乌尔克维奇（A. Biulkevitch）；发起小组主席：舒宁（Shunin）。”
随后宣读了 V. I. 格罗斯先生（Mr. V. I. Gross）的回复，以及侨民委员会通过的决议：
“在6月21日的会议上讨论了6月18日公共组织代表会议主席来信的内容后，在侨民委员会领导下运作的各组织认为，任何旨在停止俄国人之间的分歧并增进彼此理解、从而改善俄国人经济和政治地位的统一尝试，一直得到侨民委员会的认可。在其领导下运作的各组织也曾进行过几次此类尝试，而由前俄国总领事格罗斯先生领导的侨民委员会的成立，其目的正是为了在权威中心的领导下团结俄裔社区，以代表居住在上海的俄国移民的利益，并在各方面协助俄国人。同时，侨民委员会在讨论了整个问题的情况后，一致决定如下：-

page_data.en:
2442.
The Russian continued.
1) To express once again that the idea to cease all disagreements amongst the community and to attain co-operation, so as to improve the economic and judicial status of Russians is evidently meeting with approval of the wide circles of the Russian community.
2) At the same time finding that unification should be of economic and judicial nature, the migrants' committee is of the opinion that whilst being anti-Bolshevik in idea the unification should not adhere to any political group or groups in order not to create any split and to facilitate the obtaining of assistance in an equal measure by all emigrants who may wish to have their interests protected.
3) In order that the unification be fully carried out it is necessary for it to be centred around some one person at the head of the community. This person should have sufficient experience in dealing with foreigners and Chinese in order to get good results in the interests of the emigrants.
4) A business committee should be formed to assist the head of the community.
5) The only person answering the requirements to be possessed by the head of the community in the decided opinion of the Emigrants' Committee is Mr. V.F. Grosse, ex Russian Consul General in Shanghai, who has already been the recipient of a blessing for the mission of heading the Russian community from His Eminence, the Bishop of Shanghai.
6) The business committee is the Emigrants' Committee, which since the time of its formation has conscientiously discharged its duties, whilst records of the daily applications, enquiries, correspondence, etc. carried on between the Chinese and foreign authorities and the Committee prove that it deals with persons of different groups irrespective of their connection with this or that political organization.
7) These two principles viz: unification on a business platform and the grouping of emigrants around one authoritative person maintaining good relations with Chinese and foreign authorities are being fully observed by the Emigrants' Committee and other organizations subject to it, which should prove of great value to the emigrants.
8) Under the circumstances the question of unification consists simply in other organizations joining the Emigrants' Committee.
9) The Emigrants' Committee is prepared to listen to plans and suggestions in connection with the representatives of other organizations wishing to make part of the Committee but always observing the two main principles namely:
a) The unification whilst maintaining an attitude of irreconciliation towards the Bolsheviks will not adhere to any political group.
b) Mr.V.F. Grosse being the ex Russian Consul General should by right be at the head of the unification.
With reference to the question of participation in the meeting to be held on June 24, after hearing the report of Mr. Chunihin on the matter in question, the Emigrants' Committee having become convinced that the initiative group has no definite plans whatever concerning unification, passed a resolution to refrain from sending its delegates to the meeting but to send its views on the subject to the meeting.
Signed by M. Yakovkin, Secretary."
The Chairman of the meeting announces the opening of discussions. Mr. Chunihin is the first speaker. He states that he did not receive Mr. Grosse's written invitation sent by post in time for the meeting on Thursday, but on the strength of the verbal agreement with Mr. Grosse attended the meeting of the Emigrants' Committee at 6 pm. He adds the welcome accorded him was not very friendly as many of the people
page_data.zh:
2442.
该俄国人继续发言。
1) 再次表示，停止侨民内部一切分歧并达成合作，以改善俄国人的经济和司法地位的想法，显然正得到俄国侨民广泛阶层的认可。
2) 同时，鉴于统一应具有经济和司法性质，移民事务委员会认为，虽然在思想上反布尔什维克，但统一不应依附于任何政治团体，以免造成分裂，并便于所有希望保护其利益的移民平等地获得援助。
3) 为了充分实现统一，有必要以社区中的某一个人物为核心。此人应具备与外国人和中国人打交道的丰富经验，以便为移民的利益取得良好成果。
4) 应成立一个商务委员会来协助社区领袖。
5) 移民事务委员会坚决认为，唯一符合社区领袖所需条件的人是前俄罗斯驻上海总领事 V.F. 格罗斯（Grosse）先生，他已得到上海主教阁下的祝福，获准承担领导俄国侨民的使命。
6) 商务委员会即移民事务委员会，自成立以來一直 conscientiously（尽职地）履行其职责，而该委员会与中国及外国当局之间进行的日常申请、查询、通信等记录证明，它在处理事务时不分派系，不论其与何种政治组织有关联。
7) 移民事务委员会及其下属其他组织正在充分遵守这两项原则，即：在商业平台上的统一，以及将移民围绕在一位与中外当局保持良好关系的权威人物周围，这应对移民具有极大价值。
8) 在这种情况下，统一的问题仅仅在于其他组织加入移民事务委员会。
9) 移民事务委员会愿意听取希望加入该委员会的其他组织代表的计划和建议，但始终遵守两项主要原则，即：
a) 统一虽对布尔什维克保持不可调和的态度，但不依附于任何政治团体。
b) V.F. 格罗斯先生作为前俄罗斯总领事，理应处于统一的领导地位。
关于参加6月24日举行的会议的问题，在听取了 Chunihin（音译）先生对此事的报告后，移民事务委员会确信发起小组没有任何具体的统一计划，因此通过决议，不派遣代表参加会议，但将其对此事的观点提交给会议。
由秘书 M. Yakovkin（音译）签署。”
会议主席宣布讨论开始。Chunihin（音译）先生是第一位发言人。他表示，他没有及时收到格罗斯先生邮寄的书面邀请，无法参加周四的会议，但基于与格罗斯先生的口头协议，他出席了下午6点的移民事务委员会会议。他补充说，受到的欢迎并不十分友好，因为许多人

page_data.en:
Press
2443.
-----
the "usual" continued.

were quite opposed to the unification scheme. Mr. S.I.
Lazakoff was the most peacefully inclined. The questions
the meeting put to him, says Shunilin, made an impression
as though they were being dictated by people who wish at
all cost to defend their own "party" programme. After the
report Mr. Shunilin was asked to give the names of persons
who took part in the conference which he said was of in
number.
Mr. Fomin, chairman of the meeting, comments next on
the resolutions passed and presented by the migrants'
committee:-
"We have before us a document of very great importance.
It does not, however, advocate means and ways with the aid
of which the unification of Russian community can be attained,
but it presents us with paragraphs in a concrete form on
which the administration of the Russian community in Shanghai
should be based. It bears the signature of the secretary
only but is forwarded with Mr. Grosse's letter. The above
referred to document is founded on three principles viz:
The source of authority is in that Mr. Grosse as the ex
Russian Consul General retains his present position by
right of succession. We can object to this, gentlemen,
in so far as the authority of consuls and ambassadors is
based on the principle of government appointments, whereas
the emigrants today represent a national body. If the
authors of the resolutions of the 'Migrants' Committee are
to be considered as right Mr. Maklakoff, who was formerly
Ambassador of Russia in France, should now by right of
succession be at the head of emigrants in France. Our
emigration was headed in Siberia by Admiral Kolchak and
he was succeeded first by Gen. Denikin and then Gen. Wrangel.
We therefore see that that principle advocated has already
been disregarded.
The authors furthermore see assistance rendered to the
emigrants as the foundation of unification. This is a narrow
point of view. We see the tasks of emigrants extend beyond
assistance only; these should strive to obtain the improvement
of economic and judicial status for it is not right to depend
on foreign charity for ever. This is a serious matter and
one which requires immediate attention.
The attitude towards Bolsheviks is the third point dealt with.
We are recommended not to adhere to any political group in
other words not to belong to anti-bolshevist organizations.
The emigrants thus are prompted to exercise complete
indifference which is an impossibility for the majority to
comply with. No organization ever asks petitioners as to
what group they belong as it would be unfair to make the
discrimination of such kind when it is a question of help."
Mr. Afanasieff is the next speaker. He recommends
again the formation of a Commission to deal with the prepa-
ration of plans for unification.
Engineer Gleboff states then that it should not be
forgotten that we have to deal with a group of some strength
(meaning the migrants' Committee) and that it is one in
opposition.
Mr. I.M. Hendrikoff declares that the right of consuls
is not hereditary. This applies only to monarchs. The
authority of the Russian Consulate in Shanghai was passed
over to the Bureau for Russian Affairs and then to the
Committee for Defence of Russian Rights. The speaker
does not approve of the idea of a Commission, in his opinion
it is better to request Gen. Horvath to appoint his own
representative for Shanghai and thereby put an end to all
dispute of rights, etc. The decision of Gen. Horvath should
be accepted unconditionally.

“通常”继续。

强烈反对统一方案。S.I. Lazakoff（音译）先生态度最为平和。Shunilin（音译）称，会议上向他提出的问题给人的印象是，这些问题似乎是由那些不惜一切代价维护自己“党派”纲领的人所授意的。报告结束后，Shunilin（音译）先生被要求提供参加会议的人员名单，他说人数为……（原文不清/缺失数字）。
会议主席 Fomin（音译）先生随后对移民事务委员会通过并提交的决议发表评论：-
“我们面前有一份非常重要的文件。然而，它并没有提倡实现俄国侨民统一的手段和方法，而是以具体条款的形式向我们提出了上海俄国侨民管理应依据的基础。该文件仅由秘书签名，但随附格罗斯先生的信件。上述文件基于三项原则，即：
权力的来源在于格罗斯先生作为前俄罗斯总领事，凭借继承权保留其现有职位。绅士们，我们可以对此提出异议，因为领事和大使的权力基于政府任命原则，而今天的移民代表的是一个民族团体。如果‘移民事务委员会’决议的作者被认为是正确的，那么前俄罗斯驻法国大使 Maklakoff（音译）先生现在也应凭借继承权成为在法俄侨的领袖。我们的移民在西伯利亚由科尔恰克海军上将领导，他先后由邓尼金将军和弗兰格尔将军继任。因此，我们看到，所倡导的这一原则已经被无视。
此外，作者们将对移民的援助视为统一的基础。这是一种狭隘的观点。我们认为移民的任务不仅仅局限于援助；他们应致力于改善经济和司法地位，因为永远依赖外国慈善是不对的。这是一个严重的问题，需要立即关注。
第三点涉及对布尔什维克的态度。建议我们不依附于任何政治团体，换句话说，不属于反布尔什维克组织。因此，移民被促使保持完全的冷漠，这是大多数人无法做到的。没有任何组织会在提供帮助时询问申请人属于哪个团体，因为在这种涉及援助的问题上进行此类歧视是不公平的。”
下一位发言者是 Afanasieff（音译）先生。他再次建议成立一个委员会，负责制定统一计划。
工程师 Gleboff（音译）随后指出，不应忘记我们要对付的是一个具有一定实力的团体（指移民事务委员会），而且它是一个反对派团体。
I.M. Hendrikoff（音译）先生声明，领事的权利不是世袭的。这仅适用于君主。俄罗斯驻上海领事馆的权力已移交给俄罗斯事务局，随后移交给俄罗斯权利保卫委员会。发言人不赞成成立委员会的想法，在他看来，最好请求霍尔瓦特将军（Gen. Horvath）任命其驻上海代表，从而结束所有关于权利等的争端。霍尔瓦特将军的决定应被无条件接受。

Dr. Hohlaockin sees in the resolutions of the
migrants' Committee a desire to depersonalize the whole
of Russian emigration in Shanghai. He adds that Russians
have lost a great deal, but not their honour and this they
will not submit to anybody.
In view of the late hour the Chairman proposes an
interval during which a resolution of reply to the
migrants' Committee should be formulated. At 6.30 the
interval takes place and at 7 p.m. the Chairman reads out
the resolutions passed. The silence which followed the
reading testified to the seriousness of the matter and the
impression made on persons present. The resolutions were
passed unanimously. Mr. Chunihin, Chairman of the Initiative
Group, declares that he resigns his rights in favour of the
committee of the meeting and the appointed commission. This
latter is empowered to invite representatives from all
organizations to cooperate in the work and for information
purposes. The meeting is announced as terminated at 8 p.m.

Resolutions
of the Meeting of representatives of public
organizations in Shanghai on June 21, 1923.

The resolutions passed and forwarded by the Emigrants'
Committee after a meeting held on June 21 to the Chairman
of the Meeting of representatives of public organizations
held on June 17, when read resulted in the following
resolutions being adopted:-
1) That the leadership of the Russian Community in Shanghai
by Mr. V.F. Grosse be not recognized because his
activities during the years of emigration have not earned
the trust of the Russian community and therefore his leader-
ship would prove harmful to the Russian cause. Mr. Grosse's
claims to right of succession in the matter of leadership
are groundless as his rights of Consul General for Russia
ceased with the fall of the Government which appointed him.
2) That passive resistance to Bolsheviks and Bolshevism as
expressed in paragraph 2 of the resolutions of the Emigrants'
Committee be not accepted as it is contrary to the ideas of
the majority of the emigrants and is harmful to their
national aims. The idea of anti-Bolshevism means active
struggle.
3) That the inclusion of the Shanghai united emigrants
into the Unification headed by Gen. D.L. Horvath in the
Far East be confirmed.
4) That the refusal of the Emigrants' Committee to send its
delegates to the meeting held under the pretext that the
Initiative Group had not/definite plans for unification be
declared as a poor excuse. Firstly because the invitation
to attend the meeting was extended by the meeting held on
June 17 and not the Initiative Group and secondly the
refusal simply means non-desire of the Emigrants' Committee
not to participate in the plans for uniting Russians in
Shanghai with a view to submitting all emigrants to Mr.
Grosse's sole power.
5) That the statement of the Emigrants' Committee that
its formation meant unification be recognized as incorrect
because it was then that the serious split occurred in the
Community dividing it into two separate camps very hostile
to each other, the consequences of which trouble cannot be
successfully dealt with during the past two years. The
records referred to in the Resolutions, the meeting is
convinced cannot be attributed to the authoritative weight
of either the Committee or its Chairman, but result
exclusively from the fact that the Chairman of the Emigrants'
