Hohlaockin（音译）博士在移民事务委员会的决议中看出了一种欲将上海整个俄国移民去人格化的愿望。他补充说，俄国人失去了一切，但没有失去荣誉，他们不会向任何人屈服。
鉴于时间已晚，主席提议休会，期间应起草一份回复移民事务委员会的决议。6:30 休会，晚上7点，主席宣读通过的决议。宣读后的沉默证明了事态的严肃性以及对在场人员产生的影响。决议一致通过。发起小组主席 Chunihin（音译）先生宣布，他将其权利让渡给会议委员会和指定的委员会。后者有权邀请所有组织的代表合作开展工作并提供信息。会议于晚上8点宣布结束。

决议
1923年6月21日上海公共组织代表会议决议。

移民事务委员会在6月21日会议后通过并 forwarded（转交）给6月17日举行的公共组织代表会议主席的决议，经宣读后，导致通过了以下决议：-
1) 不承认 V.F. 格罗斯先生对上海俄国侨民的领导权，因为他在流亡期间的活动未能赢得俄国侨民的信任，因此他的领导将对俄国事业有害。格罗斯先生在领导权问题上的继承权主张毫无根据，因为他的俄罗斯总领事权利随着任命他的政府的垮台而终止。
2) 不接受移民事务委员会决议第2段中所表达的对布尔什维克和布尔什维主义的消极抵抗，因为这与大多数移民的思想相悖，并有害于他们的民族目标。反布尔什维克主义意味着积极斗争。
3) 确认上海联合移民加入由远东的 D.L. 霍尔瓦特将军（Gen. D.L. Horvath）领导的统一体。
4) 移民事务委员会以发起小组没有明确统一计划为借口拒绝派遣代表参加会议，此举被 declared（宣告）为拙劣的借口。首先，因为参加会议的邀请是由6月17日的会议发出的，而非发起小组；其次，拒绝 simply（仅仅）意味着移民事务委员会不愿参与将上海俄国人统一的计划，其目的是使所有移民服从格罗斯先生的独裁权力。
5) 移民事务委员会声称其成立即意味着统一，这一说法被认定为不正确，因为正是在那时，侨民内部发生了严重的分裂，将其分为两个彼此非常敌对的阵营，其后果在过去两年中未能成功处理。会议确信，决议中提到的记录不能归因于委员会或其主席的权威分量，而完全是因为移民事务委员会主席的……（原文中断）

The "Shanghai Larya" of June 30th writes as follows:-
Political.
Bolshevist work.
There is nothing surprising for Russians in the reports that agents of the III International have been planning to undermine British supremacy by approaching its trade fleet. It would be more astonishing for Russians to know that the Bolsheviks have ceased to propagate their doctrines with a view to creating a social revolution in the world. Nations should not forget that in the event of another Great War, Bolshevism will assume great dimensions because it has a knack of uniting dissatisfied elements of which there are plenty in every country. All attempts at creating an anti Soviet international league have so far failed. Europe is pursuing her usual course and sooner or later will find herself in the abyss of civil war. Such facts as the mild sentence passed on the criminal BelaKun prove once again that the "old world" is still blind and lacks courage. This, however, helps the III International to build its hopes on and the hour of world wide revolution is not as far off as some may think.

Japanese colonisation of Manchuria and Mongolia.
Small groups of emigrants are being continually despatched from Japan to settle in Manchuria and Mongolia with a view to colonization and cultivation of natural resources in the above countries. There exists a society known as the "Society of development of Manchuria and Mongolia" which promotes this emigration.

The "Russia" of June 30th writes as follows:-
Russian.
The Society of Russian Youth.
The Society of Russian Youth will shortly have an official opening of their new Club situated in Rue Ratard and Route de ... corner.

The "Echo" of June 29th writes as follows:-
Russian.
Unification problem.
The decision of some Russian emigrant organizations to declare their distrust of Mr. V.Fl Grosse, who is the Head of the Russian Emigrants' Committee in Shanghai, has created a great deal of excitement in wide circles. The Emigrants' Committee is receiving protests from various organizations against the decisions reached at the meeting held on the initiative of Mr. Chunihin. It has therefore been decided to convene a meeting of all representatives of organisations adhering to the Emigrants' Committee to discuss the above matter. The meeting will be attended by about 60 delegates from various organizations including the Labour Corps, the Engineer Corps, Electric Power Station and other Russian labour organizations. The meeting will be held to-morrow at 2 p.m. at the offices of the Emigrants' Committee

6月30日的《上海黎明报》（Shanghai Larya）写道：——
政治。
布尔什维克活动。
关于第三国际代理人企图通过接触英国商船队来破坏英国霸权的报道，对俄国人来说并不令人惊讶。更令俄国人感到惊讶的或许是得知布尔什维克已停止宣传其学说，不再旨在世界范围内制造社会革命。各国不应忘记，一旦再次爆发世界大战，布尔什维主义将大规模蔓延，因为它擅长团结各国都大量存在的不满分子。迄今为止，建立反苏维埃国际联盟的所有尝试均告失败。欧洲正沿着其惯常轨道前行，迟早会陷入内战的深渊。诸如对罪犯贝拉·库恩（Bela Kun）判处轻刑之类的事实，再次证明“旧世界”仍然盲目且缺乏勇气。然而，这反而助长了第三国际的希望，世界革命的时刻并不像某些人认为的那样遥远。

日本在满洲和蒙古的殖民化。
日本不断向满洲和蒙古派遣小规模移民群体，旨在对上述地区进行殖民开发及自然资源 cultivation。有一个名为“满蒙开发协会”的社团在推动这一移民活动。

统一问题。
部分俄侨组织决定宣布不信任上海俄侨委员会主席弗·格罗斯先生（Mr. V.Fl Grosse），此举在广泛阶层中引起了极大轰动。俄侨委员会正收到各组织针对春希金先生（Mr. Chunihin）发起召开的会议所达成决议的抗议。因此，决定召开所有隶属于俄侨委员会的组织代表会议，讨论上述事项。届时将有来自劳工团、工程团、发电站及其他俄侨劳工组织等约60名代表出席。会议将于明日下午2时在俄侨委员会办公室举行。

The meeting further decided:-
1) To publish the Resolutions of the Migrants' Committee
of June 21 and the Resolutions of the meeting as above in
all local newspapers.
2) To inform Gen. ... Horvath of the proceedings in connec-
tion with unification in Shanghai with all details and to
elect a Commission for the purpose and the carrying out of
plans.
3) To entrust the Commission to convene meetings from time
to time to be attended by representatives of public
organizations including those already connected with the
movement and others desiring to join. The representatives
to co-operate in the work of the Commission and discussion
of questions liable to arise in the course of the unification
movement.

Editorial re Unification.

The second general meeting of Russian representatives
was held on Sunday and attended by 47 delegates proves the
necessity of unification. This time the idea originated
from the mass of people, the initiative group showed itself
energetic and the call having been heard by practically
all organizations the unification has begun. As might have
been expected the appeal did not find a response in the
Migrants' Committee of which Mr. Grosse is the head. This
is very characteristic for the ideas prevalent in Shanghai
emigrants' circles. The opponent of the Committee named above
viz: the Committee for Defence of Rights eagerly welcomed
the idea of unification and even went to the extent of being
prepared to submit entirely to the decisions of Gen. Horvath.
If readers read the resolutions passed by different parties
they will have a clear idea of how things stand. Again
whilst the Committee for Defence of Rights is prepared to
dissolve if necessary in conjunction with instructions from
higher authorities in the face of Gen. Horvath the Migrants'
Committee refuses to recognize any other authority and sees
unification possible only under the leadership of Mr. Grosse.
It simply says: "Join the Emigrants' Committee and submit to
its head". Then also whilst the Russian organizations here
wish to maintain their political face in the interests of
economic and judicial status of Russians, by means of
supporting the idea of opposition to Bolshevism the Migrants'
Committee advocates passive resistance. Besides if there is
a desire for joint work and unity the Migrants' Committee
should not refuse to co-operate with other organizations in
the matter of such importance. The Initiative group is to
be congratulated for having aroused the spirit of Russians
which for a time seemed to have completely died down. The
future will show how the movement for unification will
terminate in the meantime activity has begun.

A split in the groups of Emigrants' Committee.

It is reported that a split occurred after the meeting
held on June 21 by representatives of groups of Emigrants'
Committee. The resolutions are alleged not to have been signed
by all concerned. Also that Chairman of the Russian Merchants'
Union was not authorised to refuse to take part in the negoti-
ations re unification; this applies in some ways to the
Cossack groups too.

委员会担任工部局俄事顾问职位。
会议进一步决定：——
1) 在所有本地报纸上刊登6月21日移民事务委员会的决议以及上述会议的决议。
2) 将所有有关上海统一事宜的详细进展通知霍尔瓦特将军（Gen. ... Horvath），并为此目的选举一个委员会以执行相关计划。
3) 委托该委员会不定期召开会议，邀请公共组织代表参加，包括那些已经参与运动的组织以及希望加入的其他组织。代表们将协助委员会工作，并讨论统一运动过程中可能出现的问题。

关于统一的社论。

周日举行的第二次俄侨代表会议有47名代表出席，证明了统一的必要性。此次理念源于民众，发起小组表现出积极性，呼吁得到了几乎所有组织的响应，统一工作已经开始。正如预料的那样，该呼吁未得到由格罗斯先生领导的移民事务委员会的回应。这非常具有上海俄侨界流行思想的特征。上述委员会的对手，即权利保护委员会，热情欢迎统一的理念，甚至表示准备完全服从霍尔瓦特将军的决定。如果读者阅读各派通过的决议，就会对局势有清晰的了解。此外，虽然权利保护委员会准备在必要时根据上级指示并在霍尔瓦特将军面前解散自身，但移民事务委员会拒绝承认任何其他权威，认为只有在格罗斯先生的领导下才可能实现统一。它 simply 说：“加入俄侨委员会并服从其领导人”。此外，虽然这里的俄侨组织希望通过支持反对布尔什维主义的理念来维护俄侨在经济和司法地位上的政治面貌，但移民事务委员会却主张消极抵抗。此外，如果有共同工作和团结的愿望，移民事务委员会不应拒绝在其他组织如此重要的事项上进行合作。应祝贺发起小组唤醒了似乎一度完全沉寂的俄侨精神。未来将显示统一运动如何结束，与此同时，行动已经开始。

俄侨委员会各团体的分裂。

据报道，在6月21日由俄侨委员会各团体代表举行的会议之后发生了分裂。据称决议并非由所有相关人员签署。另据称，俄国商人联合会主席无权拒绝参加有关统一的谈判；这在某种程度上也适用于哥萨克团体。

Date March 13, 1929.

Subject (in full) Russian Patriotic Society for Salvation of Russia,

Made by D.S. Ovsianikoff Forwarded by J.R. Givens A.C. Pol.

At 4 p.m. March 17 a meeting attended by about
62 representatives of various local Russian organizations,
not recognizing the authority of Russian Emigrants' Committee
headed by Mr. V.F. Grosse, was held in the premises of the
Russian Merchants' Club, 8 Yates Road, instead of the premises
of the Royal Asiatic Society as stated in the attached report
dated March 13.. Captain N. U. Fomin was appointed Chairman
and in a brief speech outlined the general status of the
various Russian organizations at the time of the arrival of
Russian refugees in Shanghai in 1922 and 1923. He further
stated that the meeting of representatives was specially
called to devise ways and means to bring about the unification
of all Russians in Shanghai and in this connection outlined
a plan which, he stated, would be most effective. He stated
that the Russian emigrants should establish an association
in Shanghai which might be known as the Russian National
Society and which should consist of a Council, Executive
Committee and Control Committee. Capt. Fomin's suggestion
was put to the meeting and passed by the majority of those
present and in consequence a select Committee of ten men were
elected to complete the work of establishing the Russian
National Society.

The following persons were elected to serve
on the Select Committee:-

S H A N G H A I.

Dear Sir:- REPORT

On 20th December 1928, by group of Russian emigrant political and social promoters was held in my presence a first meeting of the certain workers concerning the ways they might unify the Russian emigrants altogether for the fighting with the common enemy as of our native land as of the whole world, i.e.:- with the Bolshevik Communists. In that meeting were present members of some local emigrant organizations and some of Shanghai's Facist. Above said meeting decided to make a new organization of the conspiring character and named "The Russian Patriotic Society for Russia's Release."

The principal action of that organization is an unmerciful struggling against the Soviet Government and organization, the units of rioters into the Russian country quite close the common Russian White coming.

This work we reckon in our duty to make it in according to the regulations of the International Settlement, and maintenance of the sovereign rights of China.

Simultaneously "The Russian Patriotic Society for Salvation Russia's Release" supposes the series of works about being of Russian emigrants there in Shanghai.

And for that reason our organization is supposing to call together the Common Meeting of Russian emigrants of the Shanghai city about emigrant unification as on the economical ground as judicially.

That supposal was from the initiative group consumed and our official petition from the name of the initiative group made was for that reason we did not want our organization i.e. "Russian Patriotic Society for Salvation of Russia" as a conspiring organization were revealed by our enemies - Bolsheviks.

亲爱的先生：—— 报告

1928年12月20日，在我面前，一群俄侨政治和社会促进者举行了第一次某些工人的会议，讨论他们如何能够统一所有俄侨，以对抗我们祖国乃至全世界的共同敌人，即：布尔什维克共产主义者。出席会议的有一些本地侨民组织的成员以及一些上海的法西斯主义者。上述会议决定成立一个新的具有密谋性质的组织，命名为“俄罗斯解放爱国会”。

该组织的主要行动是对苏维埃政府和组织进行无情的斗争，将暴乱分子单位送入俄国境内，这与普通的俄国白军到来非常接近。

我们认为，按照国际租界的规章并维护中国的主权权利来进行这项工作是我们的责任。

同时，“俄罗斯解放爱国救俄会”设想开展一系列关于在上海的俄侨身份的工作。

出于这个原因，本组织打算召集上海全市俄侨举行全体会议，讨论在经济和司法基础上的侨民统一问题。

这一设想已由发起小组采纳，并以发起小组的名义提出了正式请愿，原因是我们不希望我们的组织，即“俄罗斯爱国救俄会”，作为一个密谋组织被我们的敌人——布尔什维克所揭露。

- 霍尔瓦特（Horwatt） 6月14日，我收到北京普勒马特（Pleumart）先生（将军）发来的电报，要求我推迟联席会议。伊万诺夫（Ivanoff）先生（俄罗斯协会联盟主席）也收到了类似内容的电报。该电报刊登于1928年6月15日《上海柴拉报》（Shanghai Zara）第786期。
同日傍晚6时，召开了一次特别会议，出席者如下：伊万诺夫先生，主席（俄罗斯协会联盟）；瓦尔特（Valter）将军；阿法纳西耶夫（Affanasieff）将军；福明（Fomin）上尉；霍赫拉奇金（Hohlachkin）博士，以及本人。
在上述会议上，决定推迟俄罗斯侨民联席会议，改为举行上海各社会组织代表会议，每个组织派出两名代表，会议最终定于1928年6月17日下午4时举行。
1928年6月17日，上海各社会组织代表会议在49名代表出席的情况下举行。
在同一次会议上，除上述人员外，还有奥西安尼科夫（Oysiannikof）和贝贝宁（Bebenin）两位中士，德利马尔斯基（Delimarsky）准将等人出席，并举行了此类会议。

At one of such a meeting a Committee was elected for the
purpose of laying a scheme of works regarding the general
unification of Russian emigrants there in Shanghai. As mem-
bers of that Committee were elected Mr.Ivanoff President Union
of Russian Assoc., Mr.Valter General, Mr.Affanassieff General,
Mr.Fomin Captain, Mr.Shaditsky Colonel, Mr.Schelkin Councillor
of state, Mr.Shendrikoff Lawyer, Mr.Mohlachin Dr., Mr.Biluko-
vich Captain, Mr.Selivanoff Prof:Mr.Kobliansky Captain, Mr.
Ballog Lieut., Mr.Vedernikoff Lieut., and myself.

From that time the initiative group has been given over all
his work to the Committee and Meeting of delegates.

At present "Russian Patriotic Society for Salvation of Russia"
is negotiating with the China National Government about transmitting
the building of the former Russian Consulate General in the hands
of the Russian Organizations.

The base for these negotiations is a decision of the most organi-
zations there in Shanghai from 30th October 1928 where they authorized
"The Russian Patriotic Society for Salvation of Russia" to open the
negotiations with the Chinese Officials about returning the former
Russian Consulate General in the hands of the Russian local organi-
zations.

About all abovesaid I have my duty to inform you Sir.

The Statute of our group I shall deliver to you Sir, after it
will be ratified by the "Chief Management of the Russian Patriotic
Group for Russia's Release" in Paris.

More detailed information about our local work may be obtained
from the newspaper "Shanghai Zara" No.782/137, 789/141 and 795/147.

Yours faithfully,

George Shmidth.

Colonel,
President -"Russian Patriotic Soc.,
for Salvation of Russia."

在此类会议之一中，选举产生了一个委员会，旨在制定关于在上海实现俄罗斯侨民全面统一的工作方案。该委员会成员当选者包括：伊万诺夫先生，俄罗斯协会联盟主席；瓦尔特将军；阿法纳西耶夫将军；福明上尉；沙季茨基（Shaditsky）上校；谢尔金（Schelkin）国家顾问；申德里科夫（Shendrikoff）律师；莫赫拉钦（Mohlachin）博士；比卢科维奇（Bilukovich）上尉；谢利瓦诺夫（Selivanoff）教授；科比扬斯基（Kobliansky）上尉；巴洛格（Ballog）中尉；韦杰尔尼科夫（Vedernikoff）中尉，以及本人。

从那时起，发起小组已将其所有工作移交给委员会和代表会议。

目前，“俄罗斯爱国救俄会”正与中国国民政府谈判，请求将前俄罗斯总领事馆大楼移交给俄罗斯组织管理。

这些谈判的基础是1928年10月30日上海大多数组织作出的一项决定，其中授权“俄罗斯爱国救俄会”就归还前俄罗斯总领事馆给俄罗斯地方组织一事，与中国官员展开谈判。

关于上述所有事项，我有责任向阁下报告。

本团体的章程将在经巴黎“俄罗斯爱国解放团体最高管理局”批准后呈送阁下。

关于我们本地工作的更详细信息，可查阅《上海柴拉报》第782/137、789/141和795/147期。

此致
敬礼，

乔治·施密特（George Shmidth）。

上校，
主席 - “俄罗斯爱国救俄会”

Resolution passed by the Meeting of the representatives of the
public organizations of Shanghai.

June 24-th, 1928.

The extract from the resolution passed on June 21st by the
Russian Emigrant Committee sent by the Chairman of this # Com-
mittee to the Chairman of the Meeting was read and the Meeting
unanimously passedthe following resolution:

1/ The leadership of Mr.V.Th.Grosse is unacceptable as du-
ring all the years of emigration his activities have not gained
confidence of the Russian community of Shanghai and, therefore,
his leadership would be harmful to all Russian affairs.Mr.Grosse"
s claim for the leadership under the pretext of succession of
his authority is entirely baseless as his authority as the Rus-
sian Consul-General ended at the moment of the downfall of the
Government which had accredited him.

2/ The Meeting is convinced that the possive inactive attitu-
de towards the Bolsheviks and Bolshevism declared in the para-
graph 2 of the resolution passed by the E.C.*) does not suit the
ideals of the greater part of the Russian emigration and cont-
radicts being national aims because an isolated position of all
white Russian unification and denial of an active struggle aga-
inst bolshevism exclude their anti-bolshevik being struggle and
action.

3/ The Meeting confirm that the unified white Russian emgra-
tion of Shanghai enter into the Far-Eastern Emigrant Unification
under the leadership of General Norvath.

4/ The E.C."s refusal to send their repre sentatives to this
Meeting under the pretext that the Initiative Group has no dis-
tinct plan of the unification is unlogical as firstl this Group
has convened the Meeting just for the working out of such a plan
and,secondly,the invitation has been sent to the E.C.not by the
Initiative Group but by the Meeting which took place on june17th(
Therefore,the Meeting is convinced that the E.C."aref s refusal
has been dictated only by their unwilling ness to participate
in the work for unification of the Russian emigration at Shang-
hai and their tendency to bring forcibly all the white Russian
emigration under the leadership of Mr.V.Grosse.

5/ has the Assertion of the E.C."s resolution that the estab-
lishment of the E.C."has always had the object of unification
of the Russian community is untrue asthe very fact and way of
its creation have led to the great discord which has divided
the Russian community into two irreconcilable factions and,not-
withstanding many attempts,could not be ended dwing two years.
As to the figures of the E.C."s activities to which its reso-
lution points out the Meeting is convinced that these figures ca
can be explained only by the fact that at the head of the E.C.
stands a man that is simultaneously the Counsellor on Russian
Affairs at the Sh.M.C.,and not owing to his and the Committee
"s popularity.

*) E. C. = Emigrant Committee.
this resolution if you want can see, newspaper ,,Shanghai Zaria" N 795/147.

上海公共组织代表会议通过的决议。

1928年6月24日。

宣读了由该委员会主席发送给会议主席的、关于俄罗斯侨民委员会于6月21日通过的决议摘录，会议一致通过以下决议：

1/ V.Th.格罗斯（V.Th.Grosse）先生的领导是不可接受的，因为在流亡期间的所有岁月里，他的活动并未赢得上海俄罗斯社区的信任，因此，他的领导将对所有俄罗斯事务有害。格罗斯先生以继承其权力为借口声称拥有领导权是毫无根据的，因为作为俄罗斯总领事的权力在任命他的政府垮台的那一刻即告终止。

2/ 会议确信，移民委员会（E.C.*）通过的决议第2段中宣布的对布尔什维克和布尔什维主义的消极不抵抗态度，不符合大部分俄罗斯侨民的理想，并且违背了民族目标，因为所有白俄罗斯统一组织的孤立立场以及否认积极反对布尔什维主义的斗争，排除了他们的反布尔什维克斗争和行动。

3/ 会议确认，上海统一的白俄罗斯侨民加入在诺尔瓦特（Norvath）将军领导下的远东侨民统一组织。

4/ 移民委员会以发起小组没有明确的统一计划为借口拒绝派代表参加本次会议是不合逻辑的，因为首先，该小组召开会议正是为了制定这样的计划；其次，邀请信并非由发起小组发出，而是由6月17日举行的会议发出（因此，会议确信，移民委员会的拒绝仅仅是出于他们不愿意参与上海俄罗斯侨民统一工作，以及他们倾向于强行将所有白俄罗斯侨民置于V.格罗斯先生领导之下的倾向。

5/ 移民委员会决议中断言建立该委员会的目的始终是为了统一俄罗斯社区，这是不真实的，因为其成立的事实和方式导致了巨大的分歧，将俄罗斯社区分裂为两个不可调和的派系，尽管多次尝试，两年内仍未能结束这种分裂。至于移民委员会决议中指出的其活动数据，会议确信，这些数据只能解释为移民委员会负责人同时担任工部局俄罗斯事务顾问这一事实所致，而非由于其本人及委员会的声望。

*) E. C. = 移民委员会 (Emigrant Committee)。
如需查看此决议，可参阅《上海柴拉报》第795/147期。
乔治·丘梅利（georg Chumely）

On February 7 the staff of the Public Safety Bureau were paid their
January wages.

The troops under General Hsiung Shih-hwei, local Defence Commissioner,
were also paid for December and January. His officers, however, received
only portion their wages as under:-
Salary over $200 ....................70%
" " $100 ....................80%
" " $50.....................90%

With a view to cutting down expenses, the services, of ten counsellors,
16 adjutants and some ten detectives attached to the Defence Commissioner's
Headquarters have been dispensed with.

On the occasion of China New Year, Kiangnan Arsenal will suspend work
from February 9 to 13 inclusive but the Kiangnan Dock will shut down for
one day only -- February 10.

As the result of several meetings by various local Russian organizations
held in October and November 1928 in the premises of the Russian Ex-Officers
Club then situated at 275 Avenue Joffre, a new Russian organization
entitled "The Russian Patriotic Society for the Restoration of Russia" has
been formed. The president of this organization is Mr. Chunihin, who is
assisted by General Ogloblin and Mr. Gleboff an engineer but so far no
offices have been rented. It is reported that Mr. Chunihin in the name of
the said Society made application to the Nationalist Government for the
return of the local Ex-Soviet Consulate building to the organization which
he represents and has received a reply from General Chiang Kai-shek's
Secretary to the effect that if the various consuls in Shanghai would
consent to the proposition the National Government would offer no objection.
In consequence of this representations are being made to the various
Consuls in Shanghai by Mr. Chunihin to secure their cooperation in the matter.

Picketing groups belonging to the Anti-Japanese Boycott Association
continued the search for Japanese goods in the Chinese controlled territory
on February 7.

1929年2月8日。

2月7日，公共安全局职员发放了一月份工资。

当地防卫专员熊式辉（Hsiung Shih-hwei）将军麾下的部队也发放了十二月和一月的军饷。然而，其军官仅领取了部分工资，比例如下：
薪水超过200元 ....................70%
" " 100元 ....................80%
" " 50元.....................90%

为了削减开支，已裁撤附属于防卫专员总部的十名顾问、16名副官和约十名侦探的服务。

值此中国新年之际，江南兵工厂将从2月9日至13日（含）停工，但江南船坞仅关闭一天——2月10日。

1928年10月和11月，各俄罗斯地方组织在位于霞飞路275号的俄罗斯退役军官俱乐部 premises 举行多次会议后，成立了一个新的俄罗斯组织，名为“俄罗斯爱国复俄会”。该组织主席为丘尼欣（Chunihin）先生，由奥格洛布林（Ogloblin）将军和工程师格列博夫（Gleboff）先生协助，但截至目前尚未租赁办公场所。据报道，丘尼欣先生以该协会名义向国民政府申请将当地前苏维埃领事馆大楼归还给他所代表的组织，并收到蒋介石将军秘书的回复，称如果上海各位领事同意该提议，国民政府将不持异议。因此，丘尼欣先生正向上海各位领事进行交涉，以争取他们在此事上的合作。

属于抵制日货协会的纠察队于2月7日继续在华界搜寻日货。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

File No.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / Central Station / 9257）
Date October 8, 19 29
Recd. 9. 10. 29.

Subject (in full) The Shanghai United Club, 5 Weihaiwei Road.

Made by D.S. Satula. Forwarded by Inspector Dunne.

Sir;
Acting in accordance with instructions, the undersigned visited the Shanghai United Club, No. 5 Weihaiwei Road, at 11.15p.m. on the 5-10-29 when everything was being run in orderly manner. At the time of my visit there were about 25 to 30 members and guests, including a few ladies practically all of American and British nationality.
Dancing to a Jazz band was in progress in the lotto rooms on the ground floor, 5 couples taking part. The card room on the 2nd floor was deserted at the time and the remainder of the visitors and guests were then occupying the drawing room and Bar, but the majority of them had left the premises by midnight.
As compared with other Russian clubs, this place appears highly respectable. Nominally all members of the Russian Patriotic League are members of the club, but the chairman, Mr. Chunihin, finds them unsuitable as members and intends to get rid of them gradually. According to a board exhibited, there are 50 to 60 members but as it is anticipated that the membership will increase, the management intend taking over the adjoining premises which are expected to be vacated in the near future, but at present occupied by the Portuguese Consular Authorities who are removing elsewhere. Attached is a copy of the Rules and Bye-Laws of the club.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
JAS Satula
D.S.

日期 1929年10月8日
收到于 29年10月9日。

事由（全称） 威海卫路5号上海联合俱乐部。

呈报人 D.S.萨图拉 (D.S. Satula)。经由邓恩巡官 (Inspector Dunne) 转呈。

先生；
遵照指示，具名人在1929年10月5日晚上11点15分访问了威海卫路5号的上海联合俱乐部，当时一切运作井然有序。在我访问时，约有25至30名会员和宾客，包括几位女士，几乎全为美国和英国国籍。
底层的乐透室 (lotto rooms) 内正伴随爵士乐队演奏进行舞会，有5对舞伴参加。二楼的牌室当时空无一人，其余访客和宾客则占据着客厅和酒吧，但大多数人在午夜前已离开该处。
与其他俄国俱乐部相比，此地显得非常体面。名义上，俄罗斯爱国联盟的所有成员均为该俱乐部会员，但主席丘尼欣先生 (Mr. Chunihin) 认为他们不适合作为会员，并打算逐步清除他们。根据展示的告示板显示，现有会员50至60人，但由于预计会员人数将增加，管理层打算接管邻近的房屋，这些房屋预计不久后将腾空，但目前由正在迁往他处的葡萄牙领事当局占用。随函附上俱乐部章程及附则副本一份。

此致，
敬礼，
JAS 萨图拉
D.S.

（左侧批注：6 B 亨利 / D.J.）
（左侧批注：Ja. Quaske / 警长 / 29年10月5日）
（底部手写批注：供 / 参考 - / [签名] / 助理副总监）

I. The Kew Born Russia Association has set upon a task of 
freeing Russia and the Russian People from Bolshevist power 
and after uniting Russia to include her in the family of Great 


Powers of the world once again. 
2e In order to attain the above end lawfulnesa and good order 


ish

are necessary above everything else. A governing power should 
mot only govern, but also serve the people, teaching everywhere 
respect for humanity and family as the foundation of a State. 


3. The State and the society must take special care of the Holy 
Orthodex Faith, allowing at the same time freedom to ali 

other professions of Paith to buiid their churches, houses of 
pre@er and have their Services. Without religion a human being 
is likened to a beast. 


4- Yathers and Mothers as heads of the family and being 
responsible for their children before God and the People must 
enjoy the special proteetion of the State. They are the 
connecting link between the past end the present lives of the 
people. A head of the faxily must be full master of his 

property and nobody should interfere by right in his instructions. 


5. The right of ownership myst be sacred. 


6. Land must become the property of the head of a family and 
the owner of such must be given every co-operation in oollecting 
varipus lots and for this,purpose exchange, purchase and sale 

of various lots should be authorised as well as the purchasing 
of land from private individuals and the peasants" bank. Land 
confiscated during the revolution will not be subject to return 
except in the case of Church owned land lots. Extras of 

land ownership should be bought ower by the Government for 

the sale to the population. 


7. ‘Trade and Industry must be guaranteed from outside 
interference with the property owned and business freedom 
allowed subject to observation of law and good order. 


8. All labourers and workers should have improved conditions 
of labour with a view to getting better pay and should have 
a right to form unions, establish mutual aid savings banks 
and obtain privileges improving conditions of life for the 
labouring class. 


9. In order to re-estabiish Russia it is necessary to 
institute compulsory education for all citizens in low schools 
and to premote practical lessons in agriculture and industry 
for the popular masses. 


IO. Freedom of speech and freedom of the Press should be 
granted subject, however, to punishment for false information. 


II. The Russian people started the state of disturbance and it 
is up to them to put a stop to it by means of establishing 

in Rusaia a form of government to suit them. In the face of 

the present state of destruction in the Country, the Association 
is of opinion that the institution of a fim Monarchistic 

and National Authority is necessary. 


i2- In order to attain their plans the people must seek support 
in the army, as a force which submits to itself all outer 

and inner enemies of the people. The army is our hove and 

our supporte

The organisations incorporated in ths Emigrants' Committee 
having discussed,at tmueir sitting held on June 2t, the letter of 
tne Chairman of thse Meeting held on June 1&8 by tne representatives 
of the social organisations, has to state that any a mpt at 
unification which contributes towards the cessation of hostilities, 
the creation of unanimity among the Russian Emigrants, tneir or- 
geanisation and which facilitates the problem of tne ameliotation 
of the economic end social status of Russians has always had the 
sympathgtic consideration of the Emigrants'Committee. The orga-— 
nisations ii-corporated in the Emigrants’ Committee have repeatedly 
made attempts tn this direction and even the idea of the creation 
of the Emigrants’ Committee heaged by V.F.Grosse, the former 
imperial Russian Consul Goneral,*fime@ at tue unification of the 
Russian Colony around an organisation sufficiently competent to 
represent the interests of the emigreants residing in Shanghai and 
always to render help to all Russians in need. At the sane time 
the emigrants’ committees, after considering the wholo matter, have 
arrived at the following conclusions: 


7. Once more to express their satisfattion, that the idea 
of bringing about the cessation of the internal strife in the 
colony and of the necessity to coordinate the work tending to 
ameliorate the economic and social status, has met with the appro- 


val, apparently, of the broad masses of tme Russian emigrants 
community. 


2- Moreover, the Emigrants' Committee esteem that this unifi- 
cation should have sconomic and social character and while being 
anti-bolshevist in principle, mmums* it must not at the same time 
join any political group in order not cause a split so that all 


Russian emigrants may hope to the defense of their interests in an 
equal degree. 


3- In order that the unification may be effective and be of 
@ character that will really contribute towards the relisation 
of the object put up, it must be grouped round ane person who is 
the leader of the colony. This person must be sufficiently experien-— 
ced in the relations with foreigners and Chinese in order to be 
able to put intd effect all that is useful to the emigrants. 


4. An executive committee, as a consultative organ, may be 
attached to tnat person. 


5- The only person who possesses all these qualifications 
as a head of the committee is, in the opinion of tne Emigrants' 
Committee, the former Imperial Russian Consul General V.F.Grosse, 
who Was already received the approval of the Very Reverend Shangh:ai 
Bishop, kaad to lead Russian emigrants. 


4.There exists already a consultative Emigrants" Commdttee 
attached to him which has devotedly undertaken the work entrusted 
to it, and the number of daily applicants to it as well as the 
amount of correspondence with Chinese and foreigm authorities 
clearly shows that it is being approached by persons belonging to 
various groups, regardless of tneir allegiance one or the other 
political organisation. 


%.These two principles, i.e. the unification on a business 
principle and the massing of tne emigrants round one person 
experienced in dealing with foreign and Chinese authorities,impli- 
cate principle of succession of authority, a principle dear to all 


emigrants. These two principles jsve already bgen practically 


realised by the Emigrants' Committee and the organisations incorpo- 
rate therein. 


&. Thus the question of unification reduces itself simply to 
joining the emigrants committee by all organisations which so far 


have kept aloof. 


9. The Emigrants’ Committee 4s wholly prepared to give full 
consideration to all wishes pertaining to the question of joining 
it by representatives of other organisations, but on the unreser— 
ved condition of the following principal conditions: 


n 

a) the united community, while preserving its anti-bolshevist 
character, will not join any political group. 

b) it must be presided over by V.F.Grosse in his capacity 
of former Imperial Russian Consul General.
